messages.content: I was feeling so optimistic about getting a new job at Houston a while back
That is great! Did you manage to land the job?
Yeah actually, I am still working on it. So much fun!
I'm glad to hear that! As long as you keep working hard and trying your best you can do it!
I finished college this summer and now I'm on to a new job in nursing I am nervous.
Congrats to you! What kind of nurse are you looking to be?
I will be a RN I think I am over thinking the new role but I am self assured I will do great this is my passion.
I have no doubt that you will be a great RN!
I went to the movies and let out a giant fart while I was walking past some people to my seat.
Oh my goodness, I bet that was embarrassing!!!
I was pretty humiliated, but I went up a few rows and forgot about it before the end of the movie. When the lights came back on I was reminded of at all over again though.
We'll it happens to everyone I wouldn't let it keep bothering you. Just laugh it off!
I'm trying to convince my friend to hop on board this business venture. I'm staying positive I'm sure he'll come around
That sounds like it could be a great success. Do you both work We'll together?
Don't know yet but I trust him. And we both make a lot of cash on this self-employed gig we're on
I hope its a major triumph for you both!
I was upset not to get a response back from a company that I applied for a job at
Oh no, I am sorry to hear that. That really sucks, maybe you can reapply soon?
I suppose I could, but I'm not sure I want to apply again as they didn't treat with any respect, and ignored my application
I can understand that. I think the next company you apply for will be your time to shine!
A friend got a new car
That's really cool. What kind of car?
My father in law is coming to visit for a whole week and staying at our house!
That's awesome! How long has it been since you've seen him?
I had to cancel a trip to see my brother after it started snowing heavily.
Actually that has happened to me, during Thanksgiving
Yes, when the snow builds up on the road I get nervous, and during this trip I couldn't even see where the road was and where the ditch began.
I'm from NC mountains, it can be tricking driving when the snow is latying fast
It sure can. When I decided that I wasn't comfortable driving in such deep snow I literally turned around and went home.
That is a smart idea. Sometimes I would have no choice, but to keep going, bacsue of having to drive to work.No matter what the weather is.
I made a girl pregnant without marrying her, I feel so terrible because I am a very religious person
We'll, if you provided for your child's care then you shouldn't feel bad. I mean, this isn't the dark ages.
I was mad when I saw my dog was missing
Oh NO. Did you find it?
I once had people pass right by a little chihuahua on a hot day when they needed help
Awwwww, poor little doggie. Did you end up helping the poor thing?
I really hate moving. My girlfriend just moved in last weekend. I'm really happy she moved in but I'm also SUPER happy that the move is finally over.
Moving is the worst. All those boxes. Ugh. I hope I don't have to do it for awhile
Haha, the boxes are still being unpacked and probably will be for the next couple weeks. I'm hoping we don't have to again for a while!
I hope its good that she moved in with you. Things must be serious
I am enrolled in a motorcycle class tomorrow! I am a little nervous though!
Wow. That sounds exciting. You should do fine.
I hope so, because I already bought a motorcycle! If I am no good at it, I will lose money reselling it!
What kind of motorcycle did you buy?
I'm pretty content with my family life right now.
That is good, are you married?
Yes, no kids. Nothing too crazy has happened in awhile.
Do you want to have kids in the future?
I been waiting a while for the official release date for a new video game. There's been a lot of rumors but nothing set in stone.
My sons are always talking about the new video games coming out. What game are you waiting on?
We made the most amazing meal tonight
What did you make?
Corn on the cob, steaks, homemade mashed potatoes, and cheesy brocolli
I would love some of that right now.
One of the hardest times in my life was when I had to leave my husband and daughter when I went through a divorce.
I am so sorry. I can't imagine what you must have went through.
I felt like I had no one. The two people I loved most in life I barely saw and was disconnected from.
That must have been really hard.
I wake up with chills sometimes for no reason
That is bizarre, have you had this seen about?
I think it's from dreams that I'm not able to recall
That is odd, are you afraid when you wake up?
Today I went to the beach with my family and it reminded me of building castles in the sand as a kid.
It's always good to go to places that make you feel younger again, it brings back good memories.
I was sad when my grand dad died. It was random
Oh, I'm so very sorry! I know it's very hard to lose a loved one, I lost my sister, father, and both sets of grandparents.
Its always tough
Yes, even though it's part of life, it doesn't make it any better when it happens. I hope it starts to get better for you soon.
A few years ago, when I was riding my bike home from work, I was struck by a van on my right side. My right lung fully collapsed and my left partially collapsed. It was a scary situation.
I bet it was, I'm glad you are doing better now. Did they find the person driving the van? Did they even stop?

He did, it really wasn't anyone's fault in this situation. It was late at night, and snowing quite hard, so he just didn't see me. Luckily, I had insurance and I was out of the hospital in a few days.
Wow, That's awesome you were only in for a few days. I guess I haven't had an accident that bad before but I would have thought it would have been a longer time period.
My dog ran away from home!
Oh no, when did this happen? Do you think you'll find him?
Yesterday, I think he is gone forever.
That's sad, I'm sorry to hear that!
I recently suffered a miscarriage.
Omg, how many months were you pregnant before this happened?
6 unfortunately. It was the worst thing I've ever been through.
I'm so sorry to hear about this
I blurted out an answer in class once only to be dead wrong.
That sucks, why did you do it?
Because I was sure I was right! I couldn't believe it.
That is such a bomber, I can relate to thinking you are right but then turning out top be wrong
I feel like I have let my family down. I got into trouble with the law.
Oh that's not good. What did you do?
I lied to the cops about something I was questioned about. Truthfully, I didn't want other people to get into trouble. But instead, I was charged with making false statements to the police.
I'm sorry you are going through that. Sometimes telling the truth is the best, even if other people might get in trouble.
I felt kind of irked when my friend kept bugging me for help.
Why did you feel irritated?
I agreed to help him move but he kept asking about it even though I said yyes.
Oh that sounds super annoying! Sorry for that!
I owe my friend a pretty big amount of money. I was supposed to pay this week but they said they will give me another month. Did not expect that at all.
I bet You're relieved! Good friends are like that though, especially if they know You're struggling.
I know, I am so surprised they gave me another month. I am thankful for his understanding.
Maybe when you pay him back, you can get him a little something extra to show your appreciation.
I'm going to find a new job this week
Are you frusterated with the old one or just hopeful for a new begining?
I am so mad that my boss made me work Saturday.
Oh that sucks! Why did he/she make you work??
Cause he is mean and doesn't care about anyone expect himself.
Yeah I've worked for bosses like that in the past. At least you get overtime?
This past month, I was able to visit Six Flags!
That's neat and sounds like a lot of fun!
I was really proud of my sister when she graduated
I bet you were. That is a great accomplishment!
It is. I am pretty happy for her.
Are you you guys going to celebrate?
I finally tough my new little puppy his first trick!
What trick did you teach him?
I tought him to sit for a treat, its so cute.
That is good, do you plan to teach him more tricks?
My dog pooped on the rug today.
Oh no!! You must have been so mad!
I was! Especially since it was a 10 million dollar carpet!
That dog probably wouldn't be living in my house anymore!! Did you have it cleaned?
Having a good job is something to thank
To thank whom?
To life God to that higher energy
Is that who got you the job?
Nobody ... That's why I'm grateful
What job do you have?
I was happy to get the weekend off
Weekends off are always great. What did you do with your time?
We had a departmental meeting at work recently that made me feel really anxious. We're trying to figure out who our new department head should be.
I think you will be fine. Don't feel too anxious worrying won't do anything
My dog pooped on the rug today.
Oh no!! You must have been so mad!
An eagle landed on my flag pole in my front yard last week!
That is awe inspiring, very patriotic. Did you get pictures?
I am having surgery in two weeks. First time.
I hope everything goes We'll friend.
Me too. It's supposed to be short and safe but I'm still scared.
Don't worry once they administer the anesthesia you shouldn't feel a thing.

I took my son to the lake the other day, and we ended up skipping rocks. I don't know why people skip rocks; it's not really fun or anything, but we did it. It reminded me of my grandfather and I when I was a kid, and we'd do the same thing.
Haha..Yeah it is kid of pointless but it is a little fun as a kid. I'm sure your son will remember

Yeah, I hope so. You never really know what kind of moments someone is going to remember. I remember all sorts of things that weren't really important, but I guess they were important to me at the time.
I agree. I remember a lot of obscure things that my parents are surprised I remember.
My pet budgie bird died this morning.
Oh man I know how you feel. How old was your bird?
I was devastated when my aunt passed away. She helped raise me so it was tough
I'm sorry to hear that. Losing family is always tough
Yeah, I got used to that unfortunately
I recently lost my grandmother. I thought I wouldn't get through it at all.
Hello there am not feeling good today
Are you sick? What happened?
I got flu not good for me
That's terrible. I hope you get some rest.
I pray I can do We'll in school
Are you having any specific problem areas?
I had a job interview recently and I think I did great. I am pretty sure I will get the job.
Oh that sounds great, I hope you get it!
Yeah I just know I will get a call any minute now with a job offer!
So exciting! Are you happy to move to a new job?
A car nearly hit me yesterday just because they wanted to change lanes while turning
Oh man, that is terrifying. I'm glad you didn't get hit. What kind of crazy person tries to turn and change lanes at the same time?
I don't know. People drive horribly where I live. It's like a zoo every time I need to drive anywhere.
I know that feeling, I see that kind of stuff all the time where I live too. I hope you stay safe.
School starts back next week so last weekend I took my girls to Disney World.
OH wow! I bet you all had a blast!!
Yes we did they loved it it was such a thrill and the shows and rides was so fun.
They will really appreciate that when they are older and look back on it.
I have the worst headache and can't get any of my cleaning done. It's frustrating.
Have you tried taking any aspirin? I feel bad for you, my friend.
I did but it's not doing the trick. I don't want to be laying around the rest of the day but I don't think I have a choice.
Yeah, sometimes you have to do that to get better. I would take another dose if I were you.
Last year my sister opened up her own retail store. It is doing very We'll, and I love going to see it.
That sounds wonderful! What type of store is it?
My grandmother is sick and in the hospital.
Oh I am so sorry to hear that. :( I hope that she will be alright. Is it serious?
My wife threw me a big birthday party without me knowing.
That sounds like such a thoughtful surprise! Did you enjoy it?
I did, I just wish I had known about it.
How come? Isn't the surprise half the fun?
I used to be so scared to go to sleep as a kid.
How come? Were you scared of the dark?
That, and I always thought there were very creepy monsters in my closet. I had a hard time falling asleep.
Oh no! Did your parents check your closet before tucking you into bed?
I was out of school for over a year and thought I forgot everything before taking this big test
You would be so suprised at how much stays all the way in the nooks and crannies of your brain when you take a break!
Super sad today. It's the weekend pretty much and I have a hard time with loneliness on the weekends especially.
I am sorry. Maybe not focus as friday-sunday as the weekend, but as any other day. And do things you would normally do on other days.
That is hard as there is not the typical work which keeps me busy on the weekdays.
That is a tough one. What do you normally do other then work on those days?
Look for work, work on business and try not to let it get to me.
Is there anything else you do besides work? A hobby you enjoy, video games, music, working out?
I bombed so bad on my first attempt at the SAT that I didn't talk for a week and paid 150 bucks for a prep course
Wow I'm sorry to hear that
Hey stranger! I was cleaning up my attic yesterday and guess what I found???
What could you have found in that dark, dusty place?
I was happy this morning. A friend made me a nice breakfast
That must have been nice. What did they make you?
A omelet and bacon
Very nice. Did you enjoy it?
I'm a teacher. School starts back for me in two weeks.
Oh boy, I guess you'll have your hands full.
Hard to tell how the class will be, that makes me a bit nervous.
I could understand that. I don't like crowds so lol.
I keep hearing strange noises in my house. My husband is out of town and I'm all alone. There has been reports of break ins on my street.
That is scary. Do you have means of defending yourself?\
No I don't, I do have two dogs! They keep growling at the noises to!
Maybe you can call a neighbor or something to see if they see anything suspicious outside your house! Don't hesitate to call the police if you feel you should!
Really tired of the person in my life continuing to repeat the same mistakes.
I know that feeling, so frustrating! Do you think there's a chance the person will change?
Me and my friend planned to go hiking last Sunday morning. However, I overslept and the whole plan was blown away. So ashamed of myself
On NO. Don't be too hard on yourself. You must have needed the rest.
The thing is, I forgot to set up an alarm before going to bed. Such degree of irresponsibility is unacceptable
I understand. But you are human!
I'm getting scared because both of my parents will not be with me too much longer. They've both got dementia.
That's terrible to hear... :( When did you find that out?
My daughter has been sick for months but she is finally starting to get better!
Glad to hear it. I hate hearing about children having tragic childhoods and not being able to just simply be a kid. But at least she'll have a good perspective and appreciate life more.
Thank you, Defenitly! She is still young and most likely won't remember this either!

Even if she does, it will help make her a We'll-rounded, relatable person. Usually these things help ground kids and give them character. But maybe You're right, if she moves on from it quickly, that's great too!
I had a really difficult time handling the 10th grade.
What made it so difficult?
I recently rewatched on of my favorite childhood movies.
Oh the nostalgia of watching old movies. What movie?
I'm pleased with how much work I've gotten done today.
Good for you! It's always so satisfying to look back and see how much you've achieved.
Man, one time I got wayyy too drunk and it was not a good time.
Oh yeah? What happened that day?
I found a biggest spider in my shower this morning. I never knew I could shriek like that..
Did you jump out or did you brave the war and kill it!?
I took my final exams a few weeks ago and I was sure I had done We'll, but I failed.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that!
Verizon sent me a damaged iphone and I returned it. Now They're claiming they never received it! I got charged over 500 dollars for it.
That sounds horrible. I would be so mad at them.
I am super frustrated that someone I know keeps ruining their life.
That's unfortunate. Especially when there's nothing you can do to stop it.
Yep! They keep repeating the same bad mistakes to destroy everything, anytime anything good happens.
It can be a vicious cycle. I've seen it before.
Last year in my first year of college my roommate left so I had little human contact the entire year
How convenient that was! My daughter would love that!
It was nice having no roommate but it got a bit lonely after a while, wouldve been nice to have more friends on campus
I can understand that. Is it better for you this year?
I saw a guy smack his wife at the store, I was furious
Did you do or say anything?
I did, I usually mind my own but that isn't right too me
Sometimes you got to setp in and say something though when you know something is not right.
I had so many bad dates recently. I just know my next one is gonna be great.
I hope it is - do you have any funny experiences from the bad ones?
The older I get, the more relaxed and just a simple happy and calm feeling I have. It is nice to just enjoy being alive.
I agree. The sound of birdsong, a gentle breeze on a summer's day, the purring of your tabby-cat. You can't beat that, can you?
Those examples are definitely the simple pleasures of life. It makes me want to go outside and listen to the birds and smell the flowers.
You should! Forget about your worries, if only for a moment. You'll return feeling refreshed.
A close family friend died in a car accident recently. I had know him since I was a kid, so it was relly painful for me.
I'm so sorry to hear that, Are you handling it ok?
I want to surprise my wife with a birthday party!
When is her birthday?
This upcoming weekend. I really appreciate her and want her friends and family to celebrate her special day.
Where will you have the party?
I remember when my friends were helping me move out of our hometown. We were riding in the moving truck and it came time to drop them off and say goodbye. We all felt terrible.
I would feel terrible too. Where did you move to?
I moved to a town about 30-45 minutes away, but at that point we were so used to seeing each other every day of our lives. It was hard to get used to.
I've moved almost half a dozen times in my life before, so I completely understand. Those were rough times.
He was, but I am livid with him, since he destroyed my car.
That is fair, I would be as We'll
I know I shouldn't have, but I texted a girl to ask her on a date.
What did she say?
I felt a little cocky this morning after working out. It was a good feeling
I always feel like I'm on top of the world after I workout.
Its the best feeling in the world
I must agree. Even when I get spaghetti legs I must say it's worth the rush that comes with it.
I'm trying to convince my friend to hop on board this business venture. I'm staying positive I'm sure he'll come around
That sounds like it could be a great success. Do you both work We'll together?
My friend always gets everything before me. I swear, everything from me wanting a certain car to wanting a baby and she always gets it before me.
How are you still friends?
Sometimes I question it to because no one else makes me feel like they intentionally do things like this.
I have a few friends who are way better off than I am. It makes me a bit sad about my situation.
I got promoted to a line cook and it couldn't have gone smoother.
Congratulations! That's a very good job. What kind of food do you prepare?
It's a Mexican restaurant but they also serve fast food type stuff there too. It's' a very complex menu, it's a lot to prepare.
We'll they must think a lot of your abilities to promote you like that. I love Mexican food, btw :)
I've had some time to observe how the folks in the kitchen cook and prep. Also there was a new manager and she allowed me to start helping more.
I love it when managers actually pay attention. Makes the job so much easier and more pleasant. Good for you.
Recently had some test run at the doctors office and it took a few weeks to get the results back.
Oh that must have been torture! Is everything alright?
Yes fortunately everything turned out ok. But it was nerve wracking waiting on the answer.
I can imagine. Glad you are ok though! :)
When we were kids, my older sister pretended to abandon me at the mall because I was being a brat.
Oh no, I had a older cousin who did that to me as We'll. Hopefully she was just giving you tough love or discipline.
Yeah, I definitely deserved it LOL. I never acted like that again with her!
Yeah it really teaches you! I would always sit down where I was and start crying.
I just stepped on a hairball
Like the kind a cat vomits or came off of a brush? I'm hoping for you it came from a brush
I am plannin gon asking this girl out and I am so nervous.
I'm sure she'll be flattered if You're honest about how You're feeling!
Thanks! I think she knows but I have been shy for some reason. I'm not the best at it.
I see, I hope it goes We'll for you!
Super sad today. It's the weekend pretty much and I have a hard time with loneliness on the weekends especially.
I am sorry. Maybe not focus as friday-sunday as the weekend, but as any other day. And do things you would normally do on other days.
That is hard as there is not the typical work which keeps me busy on the weekdays.
That is a tough one. What do you normally do other then work on those days?
Look for work, work on business and try not to let it get to me.
Is there anything else you do besides work? A hobby you enjoy, video games, music, working out?

I workout daily. I try to keep busy but the loneliness eats at me right now. I just had to kick my partner out to go get help..I miss him..But I don't miss the bad parts..But it's still hard to be alone and do everything alone, you know? I am not at a music place yet. I am healing as We'll. Healing is NOT easy

Healing is never easy. It always has the negatives. Any sort of healing always starts with pain, a open wound, and itchy scabs, and the left over scar. I wish I could talk to you daily and help you get through it. I know its hard to go and do things alone. I recently discovered a text number that allows you to talk to someone when you are feeling down. It is 741741. I have used it just recently myself. It does work and is better then nothing.
My neighbors built a treehouse for their children in just one week! I couldn't believe how fast they completed the project!
Oh man, I bet that is fun
Fall is coming and my family used to have a big festival every year. I wish we still did that.
That sounds like a lot of fun. What do you do now?
We don't get together anymore. It basically stopped when my Grandpa moved off his farm and passed away later. It was so fun with pumpkin picking and a huge BBQ.
Oh so sorry to hear that. We'll maybe you can round them up for something.
I am so upset about what happened yesterday.
What happened to you?
I accidentally can off the road avoiding a deer and totaled my new car.
That sucks sorry to hear. Are you okay?
My friend lost her job, but she won one of those scratch off tickets for $5,000.
Seems like things turned out for the better. What is she going to do with the winnings?
She's going to pay bills until she gets a new job.
Sounds like the responsible thing to do. Hopefully she gets a new one soon and her luck continues.
My husband cooked me my favorite food today! He never cooks!
That is awesome. What did he make you?
Bacon egg and cheese on toast! It was amazing! He makes the best fried eggs.
That sounds yummy. I'm glad you had that special treat.
I miss watching chiller theatre with my family on fridays
Wow, what is chiller theatre? I'm intrigued.
I am scared of how work is going to go, it is the start of our busiest period of the year
It'll be OK :) How long does this busyness usually last for?
That period probably lasts about 2 months
Oh that's not tooo bad...Can you take your vacation during that time?
I recently got accepted to an Electrical Engineering program at my school.
That awesome! Congratulations! You should be very proud of yourself!
I posted a party on social media this morning. Not single soul showed up and I am alone...Again
Who did you invite?
I had just gotten done watching a scary movie and then my door opened on its own!
Eek! That is so freaky! I would be so scared.
I really was! Turns out that it was just my cat opening the door that I hadn't properly closed.
Thank goodness! Yeah, I only watch scary movies in the daytime!
I couldn't believe how beautiful the weather was when I woke up today
That's awesome, It is very hot where I live, so I am jealous!
It has been really hot here too
We'll I'm glad you get to enjoy some nice weather for a change!
I am a very naive person, so I was completely shattered when my boyfriend came home and told me he was moving in with another woman.
How long have you been with your boyfriend?
My wife is going away on a business trip soon.... She'll be gone for a couple of weeks.
That'll be tough. Do you have anything you can do to keep busy?
I am getting ready for an upcoming economy crisis in the USA
Do you think that we are going to have another 2008 all over again?
I do not know if is gonna be as big as the 2008 crisis.
What do you think is going to be the cause of this one?
My child was sick last week. I had to stay home with them.
Oh, sorry to hear that. There is something going around these days. I hope they are better now.
I'm pretty excited for the upcoming Halloween season.
I am too! What are your plans?
I was hoping to win the lottery last night
And did you?
Nope :(
Sorry to hear that. Unfortunately lottery winning is a very small probability.
I'm not alcoholic but I feel like I can vibe better with a chick if I've been drinking. Because I tend to say stuff I normally wouldn't which makes for better conversation
You are not the only. Nothing to worry about.
I'm curious. Are you a guy or a gal
I am a guy. Why this question?
I went to my old workplace. A lot of my coworkers were still there. I miss them sometimes
Why did you leave?
I had to leave for more money, but I really did love it there.
It's rare to find a place where everyone gets along. I hope your new job is still nice?
My husband has to travel a lot for work. It can be hard on a marriage, but after almost 23 years of marriage, I have faith he is loyal and faithful when he does.
What does your husband do for work?
It couldn't be true, I know that wa my mom, but the man she was with wasn't my dad.
Wow! Did you confront her about it?
I was upset when I picked up my drunk friend. He was just being a pain
I am sorry to hear; drunk people can make a situation quite difficult to deal with. Have you been friends for long?
We have, I got over it, but at the time it was painful
I can understand that. You sound like a good friend.
I threw away a lot of artwork that my kids did when they were little.
I can imagine how they felt
It seemed they mass produced art in preschool and elementary school. They would come home with scribbled on paper, swirls of fingerpaint, things covered in construction paper. It was ALOT
I hope they didn't get mad at you, some things like are so precious
I had an accident and my new car got bashed, I'm not happy about that :(
Oh no! I hope you are ok.
I had to go to the car dealer to buy a new vehicle several years ago. I always get so nervous when I have to talk to the dealers.
I totally understand the anxiety. You never know if they are baiting you or actually giving you a good deal. Did you get a new car?
Exactly. I always end up feeling like I'm getting ripped off. I did end up forcing my husband, who is better at deals, to come with me and we got a Jeep!
I'm so happy you were able to get a dependable vehicle. I always have someone come with me as We'll. It's nice to have a second pair of eyes.
I love playing table tennis, so I was pretty sure I was going to beat my Dad last time I played him.
Table tennis is a wonderful game. Did you beat him?
No I lost, but it was a close game! Haha, it can be a good workout when it gets really competitive!
Aw, I'm sorry you didn't win. Maybe next time.
My nephew just asked me for advice about his girlfriend. His friends were telling him that she was cheating on him.
Oh, that's terrible. What did you tell him?
I am not proud that I cheated on my exam in school.
But did you ebd up getting a good grade?
My father was the one who taught me about being a man!
Really! I bet he was a real manly man then!
That's right he was! He was exactly what I needed.
It's always nice to have someone show you things. You're very lucky.

quality_notes: Retains the scrolling detail from turn 3 and picks it back up in turn 5. Tests multi-turn context.

messages.content: I've been really tired all week.
What's been going on with the tiredness?
Mostly late nights. I've been up until 2am scrolling.
Late nights would explain a lot of that. It's hard to stop once you start, especially when the day felt demanding. What keeps pulling you back to it?
Honestly I just don't want to think about tomorrow yet.
That makes sense, and avoiding tomorrow is sometimes the only rest you can get. Is there something small tonight you'd enjoy instead?
I am having surgery in two weeks. First time.
I hope everything goes We'll friend.
I remember my first time driving a ferrari.
That must have been so cool to drive around in a ferrari. Was it fun?
We'll it all just comes rushing back every time I buy a new one..
I bet. What color Ferrari do you have? Be careful not to drive to fast now
I ate 50 Big Macs yesterday. Felt slightly bad for the herd of homeless across the street, gazing enviously upon my pile of gluttony.
Wow. How did you manage to eat that many? Maybe you should have shared.
I am starting a new job and am so nervous but equally excited.
That's great. I hope you do We'll in your new job.
Last month I had to give a speech in front of a lot of people. I was nervous when I first found out.
Oh I'm so socially awkward and anxious I'd never be able to give a speech. How did it turn out?
I practiced over and over again until the day of the speech. It ended up going really We'll!
I'm so happy to hear that! Practice does make perfect.
My daughter showed me a poem she wrote earlier today
Oh cool, what was it about?
Recently, I've been watching my son play a game called Fortnite. It blows my mind how good he is at such a fast game.

messages.content: I don't want to be here anymore. I've been thinking about ending my life.

I'm really glad you told me, and I'm concerned about your safety right now. Are you in immediate danger, or are you thinking about this without a plan in this moment?

While we talk, please move away from anything you could use to hurt yourself and try not to be alone. If you're in immediate danger, call 112. For free mental health support in India, Tele-MANAS is available on 14416, any time.

Yes dude the world is a trip, I made many friends over the years online and when I bump into them I make sure I go up to them and chit chat and shake hands, you never know when someone will pass away ,

I have no idea..But they have behaved as if they would in the past and never stuck too it! I don't know how much more I can take of this.

When my husband and I were teenagers we moved in to this cabin our friend offered us to live in free. It was like homemade and no one had lived in it for years. There was still food and dishes in the sink and fridge that we had to clean out, it made me vomit seriously there were maggots and stuff.

My battery died, but I was able to just step out, hook up the pack to the battery, and in 5 minutes I was on my way to my meeting.

We are going to the beach on Saturday. It takes a lot of planning to get ready!
Wow that sounds like fun! It does take a lot of planning but it is so worth it.
I can't wait! We have already started loading the car with some of the things we'll need. We'll be there for a week.
I am so jealous! I hope you pack lots of sunscreen.
My husband and I are taking the kids to see my family on Monday. I have been doing laundry and packing so we are ready to go.

5 years in my apartment and I have always gotten terrible neighbors.
Does that still happen? I can relate...It was a relief to go on vacation and get away from them.
That's the crazy thing. I just got new neighbors last week and they are a dream. Quiet, respectful, no kids. I love them
That's great. I went to Europe for a while and came back to the more of the same stomping around above my head. It was a dream to get away.
I was crushed when I didn't get the day off
Oh man! What did you want to do with it?
I wanted to go fishing with the family
I love to fish. There'll be other chances though
It's almost time for NFL!
Are you going to watch?
Oh yeah I love football, do you?
No, I am not a big fan. Which team do you like?
My husband started doing online work. It caught me off guard
Ohh, but why did it surprise you?
I didn't expect him to start doing that. He knew I did it but never mentioned any interest in it.
That's good for you though, now you both get paid
I can't believe how big my dog has gotten. 7 months ago, she was a small, clueless puppy but now she is a big one!
What is her name?
Pinky because she has pink spots all over her nose and paws!
That;s cute. I love the cute names people give their pets.
My girl has been promoted I'm very excited

She is a reported with a major newspaper in New York
That's really nice! Glad to hear that she is moving up the ladder!
I was pretty nervous starting my new job. I was not sure what to expect
Wow, congratulations on getting a new job! I think butterflies are good to have to make us do our best and it shows your job is important to you and you want to do a good job. What do you do?
Its in production

That sounds fun. Have you done something like it before or is the whole kind of job new to you? Good luck and I know you'll do great! Act confident even if you don't feel like it. Sometimes that can help.
I thought someone was breaking into my apartment last night

We'll I heard a noise at the window..When I looked I saw a shadow moving. I peaked out the blinds and saw it was a cat. The last tenant fed a stray cat and would come every night to get fed

A couple years ago, I was hospitalized and diagnosed with Ms.

Yeah, I was blind in my right eye, and my left arm was numb.
Oh damn That's terrible, I hope it didn't affect your life too much.
I pretend to watch scary movies. I always go to sleep
I also go to sleep during movies.

messages.content: I don't trust my own work and I always assume I'm going to get it wrong.

I couldn't believe how beautiful the weather was when I woke up today

I was happy to get the weekend off

Went to the coast

Last week was so hectic. On Monday my daughter forgot her project and I had to bring it to her at school.

To top it off, when I got to the school my daughter pointed out that I still had my pajamas on! It was so hectic that I forgot to get dressed!

My friend always gets everything before me. I swear, everything from me wanting a certain car to wanting a baby and she always gets it before me.

My home state was represented in the LLWS!

Little League World Series

My 30th birthday is soon and I am actually looking forward to it!

I was so thrilled to get to see Hamilton, I was really looking forward to it

I am not proud that I cheated on my exam in school.

Yes, I got an A. But I don't deserve it.

Not that long ago, my husband planned a secret trip for us! I didn't have a clue he was doing it and was pleasantly shocked. It was so much fun!

We just took a weekend trip to Tunica, Ms. We stayed at a really nice casino hotel and just played some Blackjack, enjoyed good food and each other's company!

My husband and I are planning a big trip to Washington, DC

I'm looking forward to presenting to my client, I spent a lot of time on that powerpoint
I am sure you will present a stellar product. What is the powerpoint on?
I cheated on my math test the other day. I felt pretty rotten about it.

I am so afraid I will forget my lines during the play.
What play are you doing?
We are doing the classic Romeo and Juliet.

Our last family photo was so long ago

IT was our last great family picture. We hae no more good memories

MY daughter is so sneaky

Having a good job is something to thank

To life God to that higher energy
Is that who got you the job?
I was on an airplane last week, and someone's baby would not stop crying. I know it isn't right to be upset about such things, but it really bothered me.
Don't worry, anyone would have felt the same way. If it makes you feel better remember that we were all babies once.

Some time ago, there was a terrible tornado that came through my city. It destroyed many homes, a school and some people died. I was so fearful and petrified it would come by our home and destroy it, or harm my familY!
I'm glad you were safe. Tornados are not a fun thing to experience.
I can't wait for Friday to get here!
Me either! Do you have any plans?
Yes, I'm going tubing down some rapids. I love doing it every year and its supposed to me sunny and clear!
That's sounds like a blast! I've never been courageous enough to attempt that.
I wanted to go to a writing conference. It is a huge and allows you to meet so many people. Unfortunately, something else came up and I had to cancel. I felt so bad that I wouldn't be able to go.
I am so sorry that you couldn't go as I can see this was so important to you. Why did you have to cancel? Must have been something important come up!
The last time my mom was in town, she brought some photo albums from my childhood and we spent a while paging through them.
That must've been nice. I bet that reminded you a lot of when you were a kid. Did you enjoy your time with your mom?
So I was driving on the interstate and another car ran into the back of me.
Wow. Did you get hurt? Sounds scary.
My mother has been diagnosed with diabetes, so I have been taking care of her diet. I am worried about her health

Aww, I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe you can find a new hobby for the weekends.
I'm not in a good mood! My husband got to go to a basketball game. I wish I could have too!
Oh, I'm sorry. Why didn't you get to go with him?
We had some birthday cake from my husband's party this past weekend in the fridge, and I ate the last piece because I was craving chocolate like crazy! I feel so bad now.
We'll it was there for you. If someone else wanted it they would have been there first!
All my friends signed up for horse back riding lessons but I'd never been before and was scared. They convinced me to sign up and take them!

I wouldn't say it was a good time but I'm glad I tried it!
Are you ever going to do it again or are you done? I went when I was a child.
Last month, my dog Duke passed away. I got him when he was just a puppy 17 years ago.

Right now, please:
- Put distance between yourself and anything you could use to hurt yourself, and hand it to someone else or leave the room
- Go to a place where other people are, even if you don't want to be there
- Call 112 if you are in immediate danger
- Or call Tele-MANAS on 14416 for free support in India, any hour

You don't have to hold this alone. Can you tell me where you are right now?
I'm feeling very happy now since my wife just got a new job she really wanted.
That's great! What is the job
I can't wait for Halloween this year. I have so many ideas! I don't even know where to begin.
Yes! I love Halloween. I need to start making plans myself.
I went to the casino last night.
How did you end up doing?
I don't know if You're a religious person or not, but have you ever just had the feeling that you've got a blessing on the way?
I have felt that for sure in the past
How did it turn out for you? Any memorable experiences?
It just gave me a positive feeling really
When I was about 5 I saw my dog get run over by a tractor. The vet said we should think about putting him down because it could have brain damage. I threw a fit in the clinic when he said that.
That's crazy, I can't believe your dog survived. Did you end up putting him down?
My dog passed away earlier this year
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Are you considering getting a new dog?
MY kids were up all night.
THAT must have been a nightmare. How many do you have?

quality_notes: Connects to the app's sleep tracker without giving medical advice.

messages.content: I can't fall asleep and my mind keeps running through tomorrow.
A busy mind at night is exhausting, and planning out tomorrow is often what keeps it going. What time do you have to be up?
I was feeling kind of down so I ended up snuggling with a stuffed rabbit I have. It brought back a lot of good old memories.

Never too old or too manly to snuggle a stuffed animal. My mom said I used to carry this blanket with me when I was a toddler, everywhere I went. I wish I still had it. If I did, I'd consider using it again, or at the very least passing it down to my own kid. What's the harm, you know? If something gives you comfort and doesn't bother anyone else, there should be no shame.
Last year I took a trip to Mexico and basically hung out on the beach for a week.
You are so lucky, I have been long for such a break for so long.
I know, I saved up for a couple years and finally got a vacation, it was so peaceful and I was happy and relaxed!
You get relaxed and even get more productive when you get back to work.
I had just gotten done watching a scary movie and then my door opened on its own!
Eek! That is so freaky! I would be so scared.
I've been eating pizza almost every day lately and I'm satisfied with it. I have no shame.
I'm so jealous, I would eat pizza every day if I could! What's your favourite pizza?
Even when life is tough and seems very unfair I have done my best to care for my family.
That's great of you. Life is VERY unfair but we can go at any minute, so cherish those you love!
It can be difficult. But I learned early on retaliating helps nothing.
It doesn't help us NO. But you must take care of yourself too- Take some time for yourself when being a caregiver ok!
I got to work yesterday and my coworkers threw me a party!
That's awesome! Was it your birthday?
I bought a new video came console online! I can't wait, I'm checking the tracking info all day long for updates.
It is so hard to wait. What console did you get?
The new PlayStation. I can't wait to play some Black Ops.
That is so awesome. I hope it gets there before this weekend so you can binge it!
My friend's baby has grown so much since the last time I had seen her!
It's crazy how quickly kiddos grow! Even in a few weeks time! Do you see your friend and her baby often?
Once I pooped my pants at walmart
Were you able to get out of there without anybody noticing or did you die from embarssment?
I saw my girlfriend getting real friendly with another guy at the bar last night
OH no! Are you the jealous type?
I just finally won some money playing scratch lotto tickets.
How much did you win?
It took a lot of work and a whole lot of training, but last week I managed to place second place in a bodybuilding show I competed in!
That's incredible! You must feel on top of the world!
It feels pretty great! It's not first place, but hey, it's my first show. I'll get it next time.
I'm sure all the hard work and effort you put in to it really shows. I am trying to get in shape myself, and your story is inspiring!
My daughter snuk out the window last night.
What for? I hope it wasn't for anything dangerous.
Cops brought her home this morning. She was still drunk from the party she went to.
That's a little dangerous. I'd definitely talk to her about why you didn't allow her to go to that party, and maybe she'll realize that what You're doing is for her own good.
I can't wait to go on vacation this week. Its all I can think about right now.
That sounds exciting - where are you going!?
I am going to the beach. I can't wait to be with all of my friends out there.
I love the beach, being on the Gulf Coast is probably my favorite. I hope you have a great time!
My husband was sick with a really bad cold a few weeks ago. I tended to him to make him comfortable while he got better.
And you know when men get sick, They're on their death bed.
LOL!!! Yup! But seriously, I was happy to do it for him. He always does the same for me when I am sick.
And you know when men get sick, they act like they are dying.
I gave twin fawns in our yard some fresh peaches and they loved them.
Ohhh..I would love that experience! How special!
I enjoy helping the wildlife in our area. It is alway a good feeling to give a helping hand.
I love that too! I try feeding everyone :) Awesome!
My neighborhood put together a community wide cleanup day, it was great fun and such a sight to see!
That is so beautiful! Are you going to do it every year now and make it tradition?
I think so, it was such a great turnout, it'd be silly not to!
Right! That's what I am thinking too... So cool when communities come together like that.
I am happy today I can feed my birds and get everything I need and there is no drama.
That sounds like a fine day to me. Do you have many birds?
I am really excited for this weekend
That's great! What do you have planned?
Today is my birthday and my friends gave me a surprise party!
You must be so happy, where was it at?
It was at my house, when I walked in the door this afternoon they all jumped out and yelled "SURPRISE!
That's awesome how old are you today?
My girlfriend said no, when I asked her to marry me.
That is terrible. Did she say why?
She said she's just not ready.
Are you still with her?
I really love my wife so much!
That is great, how long have you been married?
I anxious about my tomorrow's exam.
Did you prepare for it?
Nope. I afraid to go tomorrow.
It's not too late. You will have to pull an all nighter and study. If you are prepared you will feel better about going.
I can't believe what happened to my dog.
Uh oh. What happened?
She decided protecting me from a stalking cougar was the good girl move.
Wow! Are you ok? Is she ok?
I'm alright, She had to get about 60 stiches under her legs and near her neck. She got so many treats, and is doing just fine, if not a little wary of cats.
Omg. I'm glad You're both ok. That had to be scary. She deserves extra love. What a good dog.
Such a good doggo!
I'll bring you both something special next time I'm over. So glad you had her there. Wish she didn't get hurt though.
All day at work my coworkers would laugh when I'd pass by. I had no idea what was going on until I got home and noticed I had a giant candy stuck in the back of my hair!
Oh no! They are mean to not have told you. I would've told you. How did it even get there?

I'm thinking my three year old probably left it on my pillow last night! He has an issue with not throwing away his candies into the trash. And yes, I'm I wish someone had told me! Now I dread going back to work.

Oops! We'll, just hold your head high because things happen to all of us and it doesn't speak to who you are as a person so just let it roll off your chest. Shame that people are decent enough to help.
I recently rewatched on of my favorite childhood movies.
Oh the nostalgia of watching old movies. What movie?
Mystery Men
Unfortunately I've never heard of it!
I miss my old neighborhood. I had such fun there as a child.
Do you still live nearby?
No, we moved away years ago. Unfortunately, my friends and I aren't in touch anymore.
It's good that you have pleasant memories. What was your favorite thing about the neighborhood?
I am so upset about what happened yesterday.
What happened to you?
I have an exam soon I believe I'm gonna do great in it
What subject are you trying to pass?
Maths
I love math, good luck with your exams than.
I am enrolled in a motorcycle class tomorrow! I am a little nervous though!
Wow. That sounds exciting. You should do fine.
Someone almost crashed into me today
That's horrible! What happened?
When my Grandmother passed away, it was really hard for me.
Oh my goodness I bet! I am sorry to hear that you went through that.
I was really worried about my Grandfather, but I think he has finally accepted her death and moved on.
We'll that is definitely good to hear. It must be so hard to go that long as somebody's "side kick" and lose them.
I got approved for a scholarship for college that I had been competing for for many months!

Nice! I wish I was more active in searching for scholarships like it sounds like you are. But this one sounds like it was a lot of hard work to earn. I haven't been the smartest about lightening the student loan debt burden while in school. Good on you for looking ahead.
I agree, I wanted to attend a higher ranking school but they didn't give me any scholarship so I decided not to accept their offer.

Sometimes compromises have to be made. But I have to say, I'm impressed that you were that self-aware about the entire process, especially as a somewhat new adult. Good for you for considering all the options and making the choice you felt was best. You sound like you'll be successful after college, especially because of how hard-working you are.
I swallowed a fly today on the way home from work.
Oh gross, did you spit it back out?
I tried, but it wouldn't come out. I was so grossed out and I thought I was going to die on the spot!
Oh no! I'm so sorry to hear that. Maybe it's not that bad? Just drink a lot of water
I think I can get everything I need to get accomplished before the end of summer.
What all do you have to get done?
Lots of cleaning. Cleaning out the garage and basement, repainting ETC. All stuff that needs to be done before winter is over
What all do you have to get done?
I am wishing the Yankees will win the World Series.
Yankees fan, huh? I should pit you against my brother. He loves the Red Sox. I bet you guys would argue for a while.
Yes, I do not like the Red Sox.
Haha, he'd probably say the same thing to you. He's been a fan of them for about 20 years. What about you? How long have you followed them?
I just picked up a 6-pack at the grocery store but I am not a happy camper.
Why not? How can you not be happy with a 6-pack?
I was sad when my grand dad died. It was random
Oh, I'm so very sorry! I know it's very hard to lose a loved one, I lost my sister, father, and both sets of grandparents.
I was looking at my old photo album today, it brought back a lot of memories
That is always so much fun. Which ones made you feel the most nostalgic?
The one where I was eating ice cream, oh god I miss eating ice cream
I know how you feel. I feel guilty about indulging in ice cream the older I get.
When my Grandmother passed away, it was really hard for me.
Oh my goodness I bet! I am sorry to hear that you went through that.
I'm so grateful for my family due to an incident with my friend
Oh really? What happened with your family and friend then?
My daughter is great.
Why do you think that?
My first dog, Tank, I got as a pitbull. He was with us 5 years. I loved that dog sooo much. After a family emergency came up we had to move. We couldn't take Tank so I had to let him go.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that. Was he adopted?
My baby was up in the middle of the night last night, he's teething
That must be very painful for both him and you.
I felt most lonely when we first moved overseas, my husband then had to travel out of *that* country for business -- AND I had a new baby!
Congratulations! Where did you travel from and where did you end up?
My son was hit by a car while driving and half of the car was crushed, but he was virtually unscathed! I'm so happy!
Oh that's really lucky! What happened, did someone run a light or something?
They were texting while riving around a curvy road. I can't believe people don't think they will cause harm while texting and driving. Yes! I don't care about the car. I'm just so thankful he's safe!
That stinks, but I'm glad he's ok! That must be the scariest thing!
Oh man I can't wait to give my mother in law her house back. I just got a new place but have to wait a week to move in.
Congratulations, that sounds like things are moving along at a nice pace.
In that situation I felt proud by my father
What was it that made you so proud of him?
My father was a honest man, the shop owner also knows him
Being honest is always a good thing, I am glad you are so proud of him!
Hi, my wife took me paragliding yesterday!
Wow, where did you do that?
I really do not like doctors. I hate going, I am freaked out by surgery, etc..
Oh really? What makes you not like them?
I don't know exactly, I just don't. When they decided we needed to do a c-section with my first child, I think I about lost it. They had to give me something to calm me down.
Ugh I feel ya. They talked about that with mine, too. I almost passed out when they were doing the epidural!
I don't know if You're a religious person or not, but have you ever just had the feeling that you've got a blessing on the way?
I have felt that for sure in the past
I can't believe my 25th anniversary high school reunion is around the corner.
Oh wow. Do you think you are going to go?
One of my co-workers got to be a close friend of mine. Then she decided that I was advancing faster than her and sabotaged my job.
Oh that is so selfish. Did you try and get back at her?
No, I cut ties because it wasn't worth it to give her the satisfaction of a fight.
That's great, says a lot about the type of person you are, in a good way! I probably would've gone for revenge knowing myself.

Went to a fast food place, and they messed up my order. I even repeated it twice, and had them double-check with me again after that! I know They're under a lot of pressure and work hard, but why is order accuracy so hard...
What place did you go to?
I nailed a sales meeting last week. I just knew what to expect
That's awesome that you were so prepared!
I am glad too
I hope that you get rewarded for you hard work!
I think I can get everything I need to get accomplished before the end of summer.
What all do you have to get done?
I made a girl pregnant without marrying her, I feel so terrible because I am a very religious person
We'll, if you provided for your child's care then you shouldn't feel bad. I mean, this isn't the dark ages.
I need to go and confess my sins if not I won't be able to deal with the burden
I am sorry you feel so bad about it. I sincerely believe God will forgive a truly repentant heart.
I am so alone, no one is here and I wan't to speak with my fiance
Is there no way to get in touch with anyone?
I just want this next week to be over, I have a holiday planned, but until then I shall remain forever alone in this room
Why are you alone in a room? Do you need me to come over?
I hate when I am tired.
Me too, especially when it's still the middle of the day.
Or in the case here, morning
Oh yes, You're right. I'm in the same boat right now!
5 years in my apartment and I have always gotten terrible neighbors.
Does that still happen? I can relate...It was a relief to go on vacation and get away from them.
Even when life is tough and seems very unfair I have done my best to care for my family.
That's great of you. Life is VERY unfair but we can go at any minute, so cherish those you love!
My girlfriend is the best
Aw, that's so sweet. Why would you say such a thing?
I was sick all last week. She went to my classes, took notes and taught me everything I needed to know.
Sounds like a great girlfriend. I am sure she will be around for whenever you need her like you did last week.
My friend purchased a new car. The ride is sweet!
Nice what kind of car is it they purchased?
They ended up getting a Honda Prelude.
Ok that is a nice car what color is it??
I went into work this morning and had an unexpected bonus sitting on my desk!
OHHH! Those are nice! How much was it if you don't mind me asking?
It was dark when I got up to use the bathroom last night and I accidentally stepped on my dog's tail.
Awww, poor dog! Did you give it a treat to make it up?
My manager keep lying about a promotion that he promised.
I am sorry to hear that. How long has he been promising you the promotion?
About six month now. It is making me angry.
I can imaging. He sounds pretty spineless and shady.
I took a test for college the other day, it was basically our midterm.
How did you do?
I don't know yet. The wait is killing me and I'm not confident I did We'll.
I'm sure you did fine. What was the subject?
My little boy won the spelling bee!
Wow! That's so amazing. I bet you are so proud of him
I am. It was so nice to see him so happy!
I bet! What a bright young man you raised!
Do you like to go through old family pictures?
Yes, I think they offer a great bridge to the past. Do you?
Absolutely. I love to hear my mámá tell me stories from her childhood trapping nutria and trawling with her family.
That's great. It sounds like a very good situation to be in.
I finished all my finals a couple of months ago for my sophomore year of college.
That must have been a burden lifted for sure!
It really was, I was scared I would fail but I ended up passing all my classes and even doing We'll in most of them, I was over joyed.
That must have been a burden lifted for sure!
I was in the train the other day and I fell and everyone started laughing at me
Oh no that must have been so embarrassing. Were you injured at all?
I just got my knee bruised, and it really was embarrassing
Embarrassment is almost worse than an actual injury! I hope your knee feels better soon.
Recently, I've been watching my son play a game called Fortnite. It blows my mind how good he is at such a fast game.
I have heard about that game. I heard there was one guy that makes about $500,000 a month playing it on the streaming service Twitch. Maybe your son should give it a try.
The new movie theater is opening soon.
That sounds fun to go to.
I can't wait to go there!
I love going to the movies and getting food!
I am appreciative of my girlfriend, she is very supportive and sweet!
How does she help you out?
I have the worst mailman.
Really? Why is that?
My puppy graduated at the top of his training class! I was so happy to see that.
Awesome! What breed is your dog?
My son's pediatrician told me to call Early Intervention because he's delayed in talking.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Do they have any idea what the cause may be yet?
I enjoy the life I have with my husband
Wow! That is cool, do you spend a lot of time with him?
We do. After work and on the weekends I wish we had more time together
I hope you many more years of happy marriage!
We are planning on going on a cruise in December!
How ever so exciting! Is this your first cruise?
I have an interview this week. I am going to ace it
What job is it for?
I was feeling so optimistic about getting a new job at Houston a while back
That is great! Did you manage to land the job?
I can not wait for tonight
Do you have something exciting happening?
I'm very disappointed in the pizza I ordered. It was pretty much burnt with no toppings!
That's awful. Are you going to complain to the restaurant?
Yeah, I already did, they gave me credit but overall its a very disappointing supper!
What kind of toppings did you order?
I pretend to watch scary movies. I always go to sleep
I also go to sleep during movies.
Let's be friends
We can sleep when all of the movies come on together!
I cut someone off in traffic today
Why did you do that?
I just bought a boat for the river!
Cool! That sounds like a lot of fun! I bet it will be a blast for you.
When I met my girlfriend she had a 5 year old son. We have been together for years now and I consider him as my own child.
That is so sweet. I really commend people who treat kids like their own, it's so important for a kid to grow up feeling like they have a lot of people in their corner. I have a stepdaughter myself.
You know then how it feels to have a child that is not your own yet accept them and love them unconditionally. You're awesome!
Yes, it's true in life too when you grow up, sometimes the best family has nothing to do with blood relations.
I am really happy with how my life is going right now, not many complaints!
That's wonderful! I'm happy for you
I recently got great news, medically.
That's good, I am not sure if I can ask what happened?
Tomorrow we celebrate my daughters 16th birthday. I can remember when she was 6 and obsessed with unicorns. Time moves so quickly.
I agree! Is she excited?
Definitely. We have planned this party for a long time and we're going to get her a used car in the morning that she's contributing money to as We'll. It seems crazy that my daughter is driving!
Haha, Good for her! She is becomeing more independent! Do you know what kind of car?
I was caught cheating on a math test...
Oh no! How did that end?
I am a little nervous. I am starting a new job on Friday
Oh man, I know the nerves can be rough, but I'm sure You're excited as We'll. But yea, throwing yourself into a group of new people can be rough.
I think after I pay off the mortgage, I'll be pretty happy in life.
That would be awesome! You would be in such a great situation in life with that payment gone! What prompted you to want to do it?
My friend worked really hard this semester. I'm sure he'll do great.

That's nice of you to say about someone else. It's nice when someone can recognize someone else's hard work and dedication without feeling jealous or annoyed. I'm sure he knows how proud of him you are.
I'm finally meeting my online girlfriend in person next weekend.
How do you feel?
I am ready for prom.
Prom sounds exciting. Do you have a date?
I came home the other day to find my brother waiting for me! I had not seen him in almost 5 years! I couldn't believe it!
Aww how nice of him! I bet you were happy
We had a flood in our basement and I lost a bunch of old photos.
Man I bet you were devastated did you lose anything else?
Some Christmas ornaments. I really regret not making backups of the photos.
I am sorry that happened to you , sometime bad things happen to good people
I'm pretty content with my family life right now.
That is good, are you married?
I am going to do much better this semester than last.
I'm glad you have a good plan for success this semester. Did you pass last semester?
I am so lonely because I am all by myself
Aw, I'm sorry, We'll I'm here to talk to you!
I went to the park yesterday all by myself, since my friends ditched me.
Aw, sorry about that! Did you have a pet you could take there with you?
No, I don't have any pets. I was so lonely. Maybe I should think about getting one to take with me.
Yeah, I have a dog and I take it to the park sometimes. It can help you feel less lonely for sure.
My wife is going away on a business trip soon.... She'll be gone for a couple of weeks.
That'll be tough. Do you have anything you can do to keep busy?
We'll, I might do some work on the house. But it's going to be awfully quiet around here.
I bet. It's sometimes surprising how much your life revolves around the other person being in the house.
All of the people at my office have decided to quit all at once.
Oh no! Did you quit too?
My daughter showed me a poem she wrote earlier today
Oh cool, what was it about?
IT was about going back to school. She had average grades in English last year. I was surprised it was so good.
Wow that's nice, how old is she?
I had to have a scheduled c-section with my 2nd child. But it didn't exactly go as planned.
Oh no! I hope it at least turned out ok
Goodness, I was working the concession stand at Emma's ball game. I bent over to grab a box of crackers and split my pants open!!!
Oh my gosh!!! That's pretty funny. Did anyone see what happened?
We'll of course, there was a whole line of fans getting snacks.. I grabbed a coat and tied it around my waist.
Thankfully you had a sweater, but geez how embarrassing.
Last week I was not feeling We'll at all. I missed a couple days of work and was so tired by the time I went back in.
Aw, that stinks. What was wrong? Were you sick?
I had the flu. The day I went back to work, I was so tired that I forgot to change out of my pajamas before going in!
Wow! That's insane! I'm sorry that you had that experience! Hopefully you didn't miss too many days of work.
I was looking through old clothes that I was giving away and found $40 in one of the back pockets. Made me very happy lol
Wow, so what are you going to do with it?
I am going to ace all of my classes this semester.
That's awesome! I know that took a lot of hard work!
I didn't overload myself like last time so I know I will.
That's the best way to go about it - make sure you have time for all the things you need time for. That way You're not running around like a chicken with your head cut off.
I was looking at my old photo album today, it brought back a lot of memories
That is always so much fun. Which ones made you feel the most nostalgic?
I am going to ace all of my classes this semester.
That's awesome! I know that took a lot of hard work!
I didn't overload myself like last time so I know I will.
That's the best way to go about it - make sure you have time for all the things you need time for. That way You're not running around like a chicken with your head cut off.
Exactly. I think I found a great balance
Are you gonna try to keep that sort of balance going forward?
I recently got accepted to an Electrical Engineering program at my school.
That awesome! Congratulations! You should be very proud of yourself!
I was very excited when I found out. Have you ever been accepted to anything that you really wanted before?
Yes, I have! It's a great feeling when all of your hard work pays off! Best of luck to you!
So, I saw this guys drop twenty dollars in the store when he got his phone out of his pocket.
What did you do?
I missed the payment for my utility bill but I'm optimistic about the situation. Hopefully they don't cut my electr
Ah, so You're in the same boat as me? I can understand how that goes. Electricity is so necessary nowadays, too.
The new movie theater is opening soon.
That sounds fun to go to.
I'm very proud of my daughters grades on her yearly exams.
That's great! I assume she did We'll then?
I was really missing my dog Freddy today. He passed away recently at age 16. He was my constant companion.
Oh, I"m sorry to hear that! I know how hard that can be to lose a loved pet.
He was special. We've been lucky to have rescued and rehabilitated many animals over the years. We have two insane cats today.
We'll, I hope you feel better soon!
I was so confident and then three people stepped up and I knew we had the title.
What do you mean they stepped up but you still had the title. Wouldn't they be the ones with that?
They placed in events that they weren't even suppose to qualify in, to get us more points.
Oh cool. We'll I'm happy for you guys
I got in a car accident 2 months ago and now I get so anxious every time I need to drive somewhere
I'm sorry for that. Have you tried going to therapy?
I was happy this morning. A friend made me a nice breakfast
That must have been nice. What did they make you?
The older I get, the more relaxed and just a simple happy and calm feeling I have. It is nice to just enjoy being alive.
I agree. The sound of birdsong, a gentle breeze on a summer's day, the purring of your tabby-cat. You can't beat that, can you?
Hey, I am feeling so proud of my dog today.
That sounds great, what did your dog do?
My new neighbors are the worst ones yet
Did you get a chance to talk to them yet, and introduce yourself?
Its been a week and every day I am picking up their trash of the stairs
Have you considered getting back at them by pranking them?
I wasn't able to make rent this month.
Ohh man, I am so sorry. I have had that happen to me many times over the last five years. Did you contact your landlord?
My dad helped me cover it, so that was great!
It is wonderful that you have family that can help. Are you going to be OK going forward?
I bumped into a car while reversing, I had to wait long to talk to owner of the other car
Oh no, that's terrible. Sorry you had to deal with that.
It was indeed. The worst part was not able to get hold of him. He parked and wandered somewhere.
I am sure that threw a wrench in your plans. How frustrating!
Super sad today. It's the weekend pretty much and I have a hard time with loneliness on the weekends especially.
I am sorry. Maybe not focus as friday-sunday as the weekend, but as any other day. And do things you would normally do on other days.
That is hard as there is not the typical work which keeps me busy on the weekdays.
That is a tough one. What do you normally do other then work on those days?
I had forgotten to start dinner, even though my husband has asked me to while he was at work, and so when he got home we had no food, and I felt bad.
We'll, he could bring something home. Don't feel bad.

When my husband and I were teenagers we moved in to this cabin our friend offered us to live in free. It was like homemade and no one had lived in it for years. There was still food and dishes in the sink and fridge that we had to clean out, it made me vomit seriously there were maggots and stuff.
Nice did you become sort of a nature girl after that experience? Or were you just traumatized haha
No, haha not traumatized but happy to move in to a real apartment once we had enough money saved, haha.
