I was looking through old clothes that I was giving away and found $40 in one of the back pockets. Made me very happy lol
Wow, so what are you going to do with it?
Oh I just put it into a little piggy bank I have, trying to get to $220 to cop some yeezys that are coming out in october. Hope I get a pair!
Nice, I hope that works out for you... Good luck

I was flying to see a relative, and my flight got delayed because of weather! Once I got on it and flew to the next airport, I missed my connection because of the first delay. Now I have to stay in the airport all alone, overnight, sleeping on the ground like a dog.
That was rough, how long ago was this ?
I had so many bad dates recently. I just know my next one is gonna be great.
I hope it is - do you have any funny experiences from the bad ones?
I told a guy I was afraid of zombies and he laughed so hard I just wanted to go home.
I'm sorry to hear that. You'll find somebody good soon!
I thank God everyday for the wife I have
You must be taking good care of her in and out if you know what I mean
My sister has been playing a song I dislike over and over and over
That must be really irritating. Is she doing it deliberately?
My favorite bakery is making donuts in a few hours.
Nice. I love donuts. Are you going to go there as soon as they open?
MY WIFE IS THE LOVE OF MY LIFE
Why is she the love of your life?
Because she completes me all the way.
How does she complete you?
It is hard to be alone sometimes, this past weekend I feel like I went through every emotion.
I know how you feel. What helped me was getting a bicycle and get out in the sun for some exercise.

I like to go outside sometimes but I try to keep my mind busy so I don't get more upset. I have a partner..Kind of..But he is away getting help and everyday I just don't know everyday how it will go or how long it will take. It's hard!
I feel you. We'll it sounds like you keep yourself busy with a hobby at least.
I got invited to a trip to texas the other week
Who invited you?
A friend
Are you going to accept the invite?
I would never cheat on a partner.
That is a good thing. How long have you been with them?
I was keeping my savings at home in safe. My house was recently robbed. The safe is gone also.
Oh no! Did you have any sort of security cameras to see who did it?
I can't complain about my girlfriend's weight, I buy all the groceries in the house
I agree, are you sure You're buying the right groceries?
I feel so guilty
Why is that? May I ask.
I went to the beach a few weeks ago, and it was great. The beach is so beautiful and serene
I live near the beach, too! It really is great. Although I've been out of town for a while, so I haven't been to it yet this summer. I'm glad you got to go there.
Lucky you to be so close! Yeah, I had so much fun, especially since I could spend a lot of time with my partner and a lot of time swimming!
Only thing I'm not wild about is dealing with cleaning up afterwards.
I am planning to travel around the world next year, starting off in europe and ending in south america
Oh wow, this is my passion too, which EU country are you going to start first?
Have you done much travel? I am going to start in spain then go to france
I have, and I plan to travel the world in 1-2 years with my wife, spain is amazing, You're going to enjoy yourself I wish you the best
I like my new manager. He is so kind and a good listener. I feel that I can trust him with any issue that I have.
That's great isn't it. I hate it when managers just boss you around and never listen.
I was so glad when I graduated college
That's such a great accomplishment and such a relief at the same time. What was your major?
I remember being younger and waiting on Christmas Day to unwrap presents. There were a lot of things I wanted that year.
I remember those times. Did you get what you wanted?
We'll I was really looking forward to the Super Nintendo. It had just come out that year and everyone my age wanted one.
The super nintendo is a classic. What is your favorite game?
I took my final exams a few weeks ago and I was sure I had done We'll, but I failed.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that!
I don't know what happened. I studied and passed everything else. Now I have to retake the class and I'm upset
Is there somewhere you can go for extra help with that course? A tutor or something?
A friend who I hadn't seen in awhile showed up at my door
I'll bet you were surprised. Were you glad to see them?
We are going to the beach on Saturday. It takes a lot of planning to get ready!
Wow that sounds like fun! It does take a lot of planning but it is so worth it.
My cat's an outdoor cat that I let out to have fun, and I just found out he was run over by a car yesterday
Oh no! How old was he? I'm so sorry losing a pet is so hard.
He was only 3 and now he's gone forever, and I'm the one who did it
What color was he- and its not your fault you were just doing what you thought was best for him.
I was all alone the other day when my kids left
Oh NO. Where did the kids go?
To grandparents house for the weekend
Aw they must be having fun with grandma.
The world would be a cleaner place if not for children.
Why do you say that?
My wife is so made that I ate the piece of cake she was saving
Lol I bet it was good
My zipper was down at work all day. I will not live that down
Oh my gosh! That must have been so embarrassing!
I dropped my phone in the toilet last night and now it's not functioning right. I also didn't have insurance on it which is a huge bummer, because this phone was expensive!
Oh no! Have you tried the old "put it in a bag of rice" trick?
I was devastated when my aunt passed away. She helped raise me so it was tough
I'm sorry to hear that. Losing family is always tough
I went to the beach a few weeks ago, and it was great. The beach is so beautiful and serene
I live near the beach, too! It really is great. Although I've been out of town for a while, so I haven't been to it yet this summer. I'm glad you got to go there.
Verizon sent me a damaged iphone and I returned it. Now They're claiming they never received it! I got charged over 500 dollars for it.
That sounds horrible. I would be so mad at them.
I was at first, but I think it was hellish mix up. I'm working it out with them now, hopefully they don't nab with that money.
The level headed approach will probably accomplish more anyway. I'm sure they have money so I also hope they don't take yours.
I felt bad when I couldn't get my daughter the gift she wanted
I'm sure she'll be happy with whatever gift you got her.
I realized I got my birthday off from work and still payed for it!
Wow, That's cool. What did you do?
My birthday is in december lol. But I just learned that today
Oh! That's something to look forward to then! Decide what your gonna do?
Probably get drunk or something. I have to start early though
Cool! That's what I always do on my birthday too! LOL
I lost a loved one last week, I felt like I was loosing my breath
Are you ok? That's absolutely devastating. I hope you have people to confide in right now.
I am ready for prom.
Prom sounds exciting. Do you have a date?
Yes, my girlfriend.
Nice! That sounds so fun. Are you taking her to dinner first?
A car nearly hit me yesterday just because they wanted to change lanes while turning
Oh man, that is terrifying. I'm glad you didn't get hit. What kind of crazy person tries to turn and change lanes at the same time?
My boss just informed me that I will be getting a bunch of unfinished work from a coworker that was promoted. I am so mad that I have to do my stuff and someone elses incomplete work!
That's so unfair. I would complain very loudly if that happened to me!
Just sent out some applications for my dream schools.
Oooh, that's exciting! What schools did you apply for?
Why can't I get what everyone is getting
What are you looking to get?
A raise in salary
Have you asked you boss?
I was happy because my best friend called me to ask about his first time moving away from home.
Wow that sounds like good news!
So when adults don't clean up after themselves in a business environment -- what is that ?! Why do they think a "mommy" will come along to clean up after them?!

LOL! This is perfect timing because I had the " You are an adult not a child" conversation with my girlfriend not too long ago. I had left popsicle wrapper on the night stand and it got sticky. I argued if you are willing to date someone who likes to eat Popsicles in bed, then you have to deal with the consequences.

LOL! Okay, y'all are a sitcom. I have to ask what flavor. (And yes, I side with your girlfriend. If for no other reason: ANTS. You do NOT want ants marching into your bed toward any potentially sensitive regions. Okuuurrrrrr?)

Okay, it wasn't just one, it was three: One cherry, and two grape. How anyone can eat just one at a time? Oh, the number of wrappers was also brought up. Like, I don't care if yuo bought them for the kids, I am part of this household as We'll. I tried to make it a teaching moment about how if you don't get the popsicles first someone else would, but I think my arguments have been falling on deaf ears for awhile now, lol
There was this one time my girlfriend and I had plans to meet a Longhorn steakhouse for a date.. She ended up keeping me waiting inside 30 extra minutes! I was pretty frustrated.
I can only imagine having to wait at the table alone, wondering if she'd show up. At least, it sounds like, she finally arrived. Did she specify a reason for being so late?
I am pretty comfy right now in my bed. I feel very relaxed.
Bed is always a source of comfort for me. Especially, after work when I feel so drained and stressed out
Yes that is the best time. I like to come home, fix some food, and dive into my bed. It is such a comfort.
Indeed. Particularly, when I grab my phone and watch short clips from my favorite TV shows on Youtube
Someone threw away my lunch at work.
I hate when that happens! What did you do?
At one point last semester, I realized I really needed a B in one my classes to get the GPA I wanted!
Did you get the B?
I was shocked when I wasn't approved for time off the other day
Why did they say no?
Too much work.. No one able to take off
I'm so sorry.. I wish I could fix that for you.
Yesterday, I wanted to cook something new for the first time, so I looked up this steak recipe and it went really We'll!
Congrats! I love love love steak and to cook
I remember when my friends were helping me move out of our hometown. We were riding in the moving truck and it came time to drop them off and say goodbye. We all felt terrible.
I would feel terrible too. Where did you move to?
I had a bunch of surgeries this year. I"ve never felt more relaxed then when I found out I was clear and they were over with.
That had to be rough, and glad to hear You're better. Do you have any follow-up appointments to go to?
Yes I have to be monitored for the rest of my life.
We'll, at least you have some relief for now. I hope that it stays in remission.
I saw someone who was making much more money than me doing a the same thing as me but a very bad job. But I still wished I was on their place and paid as much
I know what you mean, maybe ask if the place is hiring?
Can't believe mom got me a puppy!
I love dogs! I bet you were so happy.
I have a co-worker putting the finishing touches on a big project and work, and I am really putting all my faith in him.
Nice! What is he working on?
I am visiting my college kid soon!

That's a special moment. To hopefully see your kids doing better than you and all that jazz. I'm in college but my parents live only a couple hours away, so I just visit them instead, since them coming to me wouldn't be anything too special. But congratulations to you and your kid
So excited for this weekend!
Then why are you excite about it?
My girlfriend is the best
Aw, that's so sweet. Why would you say such a thing?
A character that I loved was killed off of one of my shows that I always watch. I cried like a baby.
What show is it?
The Walking Dead. It was bound to happen afterall. Didn't make it any less painful.
Ah, I have heard they are brutal with the killings in that show
I was really down after I found out that I was not going to be able to move.
Why? How did that happen?
Finances aren't great right now. I've got a lot of bills that are overdue, but I can't afford to pay them :(
I'm there too. Struggling each day. It really gets old.
I'm sorry we're both in this situation. It really sucks, and it feels unfair because it's not for lack of effort.
Yeah, that's right. I've been pushing 70 hours working a week for as long as I can remember. Hold out, maybe it'll change.
I just made the most delicious pie
Really? What kind was it?
I was mortified when my pants ripped while getting out of my car
Oh no, what did you do ?
I got approved for a scholarship for college that I had been competing for for many months!

Nice! I wish I was more active in searching for scholarships like it sounds like you are. But this one sounds like it was a lot of hard work to earn. I haven't been the smartest about lightening the student loan debt burden while in school. Good on you for looking ahead.
I think I can get everything I need to get accomplished before the end of summer.
What all do you have to get done?
Lots of cleaning. Cleaning out the garage and basement, repainting ETC. All stuff that needs to be done before winter is over
What all do you have to get done?
Lots of cleaning. Cleaning out the garage and basement, repainting ETC. All stuff that needs to be done before winter is over
Phew, that sounds like a lot of work! You better start getting on that, then!
I know I will meet my sales quota this month.
That's great. Do you get a bonus?
Yes, I get a commission.
That's great. What do you sell?
I got a really interesting letter in the mail. My Aunt left me a lot of money.
Oh my goodness. That is crazy. I've never had anything like that happen.
Yeah me either. It was a shocker!
That's amazing. What are you going to do with your amazing gift?
I saw the doom trailer today , I'm so pumped for it I'm in love with the series
When doe sit come out in theatres?
I always get so happy during the holiday season. It's coming up soon
Me too! What is your favorite part?
The Christmas lights around the neighborhood, the cold, the jazzy music, and everyone coming together and sharing presents and time with each other! It's an excuse for everyone to come home!
I agree with you. I cannot wait. It is such a fun time
My girlfriend has been away visting her mother for 3 weeks now.
Wow - that's a significant amount of time! How has that been for you?
I am ready for my job interview in a couple days. I have everything I need from attire to answers to questions!
That sounds like you should get the job for sure! Your competition doesn't stand a chance!! :)
Waiting for my brother at the airport. Haven't seen the dude in years.
Where has he been?
I saw a guy smack his wife at the store, I was furious
Did you do or say anything?
I just made the most delicious pie
Really? What kind was it?
It was apple pit, I let it cool to room temp and ate it with ice cream it was so good.
Oh I love apple pie with ice cream, it's such a good combination
I need to go buy me some new beach clothes
OO are you going to the beach soon?
My took me white water rafting with him last week. When we got to the river I started having second thoughts.
I've done that before. Getting over that initial fear is really hard. But it's fun once you do!
I know, but since it was my first time I didn't know how to act. My mind started to go blank and I started to sweat profusely.
I understand completely. It's that initial anxiety. It's a scary thing to do!
Someone stole my identity.
Oh no! How did that happen and how much damage did they do?
I was so glad when I got my first computer. I had been asking my parents for years and finally got my very own.
That's great. I just built my first computer actually.
Awesome, that is so fun to do. I spent all day figuring out how to program my Commodore. It was a treat when I figured out how to load some games.
I'm not sure what a commodore is. I don't really program much either , but I'm interested. I play a ton of pc games though.
I am looking forward to moving into a easy place to take care of.
That sounds good. Are you moving soon?
I was packing up things to move from my girlfriends house and found her son's lite brite. It reminded me of my childhood and playing with that toy.
I remember the lite brite toy. It was a nice toy to have.
It really was! The toys back then seemed to have lasted a lot longer than the toys now too!
I agree, the toys now days are made cheaply and of poor quality. Everything is about video games.
It is hard to be alone sometimes, this past weekend I feel like I went through every emotion.
I know how you feel. What helped me was getting a bicycle and get out in the sun for some exercise.
I met a girl in college and we had a date yesterday. It went very good and I am very positive about out future relationship
Nice! Do you see yourself marrying her?
For now I am only considering taking it to the long-term commitment. After that who knows. Maybe I will get engaged to her
I hope everything turns out good for you two!
How can I work so hard and not get a raise meanwhile others colleagues are. I am so jealous what do I do?
I'm sorry you feel that way. If you feel that you do good, honest work, you should demand better pay!
My boss is just being mean because I have better qualifications than him. He often tells me it's not the qualification that counts but experience :(
If it's a personal matter, I would definitely take the issue over to human resources. It's better to stand up for yourself.

Went to a fast food place, and they messed up my order. I even repeated it twice, and had them double-check with me again after that! I know They're under a lot of pressure and work hard, but why is order accuracy so hard...
What place did you go to?

Oh, it doesn't really matter, but it was just McDonald's. Funny enough, they have those new self-order kiosk things, and when I do it on there, it almost always comes out right, since I'm doing it myself. Unfortunately, you can only do that inside :(
That makes sense, but yeah, human error is a very real thing, which is why self driving cars would probably be an improvement
I nailed a sales meeting last week. I just knew what to expect
That's awesome that you were so prepared!
I'm pleased with how much work I've gotten done today.
Good for you! It's always so satisfying to look back and see how much you've achieved.
Yes, I'm usually too tired by the time I'm finished though and just fall asleep....Ha.
Nothing wrong with sleep - along with food it's what keeps us going! How many hours do you work?
I was really proud of my sister when she graduated
I bet you were. That is a great accomplishment!
Our oldest daughter rides horses and does horse shows quite frequently.
I love horses! Has she been riding a long time?
About 4 years. At the last show, she fell off the horse! But she was able to get right back on and continue the course.
Oh no! I'm glad she was okay!
I can't sleep when I'm anticipating a big event or trip That's coming up
I know what you mean, it's the excitement that keeps you up!
Yes exactly. Its like being a kid and feeling so excited the night before Christmas.
I would always try to sneak a peak of the gifts when my parents were not looking.
I am not sure about going to this new mechanic. I have good and bad things
We'll what are some things that are bad from him
Saw my brother graduate college last month! Felt so happy for him finally achieving what he's worked hard for. Hope he gets a job soon, though
That's awesome, the exact opposite is true for me. My little brother is just about to start his first year of college next month!
My father in law was diagnosed with pancreatic cancer when our first daughter was 9 months old.
That's so sad. I'm sorry to hear that. Is he getting a treament?
He passed away 9 months after diagnosis, when she was 18 months old. She just turned 18 this year, so it's been awhile. But he never really got to know her and never met our 2nd daughter at all.
Wow, that's awful. I hope you can tell her all about him and share some pictures at least.
I went into my shed to clean it and I found a dead raccoon
Oh gosh. That's awful... Sorry you had to experience that. What did you do after finding it?
I got a bag to clean up the body and I buried him,
Aww. I wonder how he died.. Poor raccoon. Even if they are sneaky little creatures, it's pretty sad.
My son was hit by a car while driving and half of the car was crushed, but he was virtually unscathed! I'm so happy!
Oh that's really lucky! What happened, did someone run a light or something?
I have a big test to take tomorrow.
Do you feel as prepared as you can be for it?
I am so ready to take it.
We'll that is a great attitude, I bet you will do amazing!!
I go out with one of my friend. This friend is so cheap that he doesn't to pay for anything. He even once embarrassed me in a bar.
That sounds frustrating, especially if they are inconsiderate and drain you of your funds. They sound kind of entitled.
I am counting down the days till my bachelor party.
How many days to go then?
My friend passed his class last semester by trying really hard
Which class was that? I'm glad to hear that.
Calc 3, it is a tough class I was happy for him
I'm about to go into that same class so I hope I do We'll too.
I was mad when my dog got loose
I can imagine. Luckily mine don't go far when they do
Yea he likes to dig and go run around the sub division.
I'm sure it was a challenge getting him back home, at least you got some exercise haha
I just took the bar exam this morning.
Oh wow like for law school? Or what you take after law school?
Yes and I am so excited. I know I did We'll.
That is really awesome! I bet is a a relief that its done now!
I was so sad when my hamster died recently due to a heart attack. Maybe I shouldn't have fed him so many cheetos. I cry every day thinking about him.
Oh I am so sorry. It's OK, it probably wasn't the cheetos that got him - rodents just don't have a long lifespan. I hope you feel better.
Thanks for the kind words. I really miss him so much. I will never find another pet quite like Bubbles.
Rest in Power bubbles. You were, I'm sure, a hamster among hamsters.
I had to go to a new doctor last week. I was a little nervous and unsure going in
I am usually that way, whenever I have a doctor's appointment. I hope everything went We'll.
It did, It was nothing to worry about
Ah. There you go so you were worried about nothing. I am glad that all was We'll.
Hi friend, something terrible just happened to me!
Oh, I'm so sorry! Do you want to talk about it?
My husband started doing online work. It caught me off guard
Ohh, but why did it surprise you?
I had to go to the car dealer to buy a new vehicle several years ago. I always get so nervous when I have to talk to the dealers.
I totally understand the anxiety. You never know if they are baiting you or actually giving you a good deal. Did you get a new car?
I really love my wife so much!
That is great, how long have you been married?
For about ten years now! I know I can depend on her for anything, so I appreciate that so much.
That must be a good feeling.
I can't help feel stressed about money
Why? Are you having financial problems?
We just bought a new car last night! It's so fancy and has so many features! I am loving it!
What kind of a car is it?
It's a 2018 Challenger! It's super fast and I am just so in love with it. I'm so happy!
That sounds great! What color is it?
I always stole my dad liquor when I was younger
Oh wow that was brave. Did you get caught?
No but I got drunk many times in the bushes behind my house
That was pretty risky. Did you get sick?
My son's pediatrician told me to call Early Intervention because he's delayed in talking.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Do they have any idea what the cause may be yet?
Not at all. I'm hoping he'll catch up soon. The appointment is set for next week and I'm pretty nervous.
I hope it's nothing too serious. My younger brother had the same problem early on, but he turned out to just be a slow developer.
When I met my girlfriend she had a 5 year old son. We have been together for years now and I consider him as my own child.
That is so sweet. I really commend people who treat kids like their own, it's so important for a kid to grow up feeling like they have a lot of people in their corner. I have a stepdaughter myself.
My wife is so made that I ate the piece of cake she was saving
Lol I bet it was good
It was but she would have prefered to find that out herself
Sometimes it tastes better when it naughty
This has been the worst year ever for tornadoes in our area. This past spring we spent 5 hours in our basement due to all the tornadoes in our area.
That sounds terrifying! I'm glad you have a basement though, it can be so dangerous if you have no underground place to shelter in!
I was so thrilled to get to see Hamilton, I was really looking forward to it
Who is hamilton?
It is the broadway show, by Lin manuel miranda
Oh okay, did you see it in NYC?
I dropped my favorite perfume and it broke into a million little pieces
Oh no, that's terrible. Can it be replaced?
One of my co-workers got to be a close friend of mine. Then she decided that I was advancing faster than her and sabotaged my job.
Oh that is so selfish. Did you try and get back at her?
I didn't get the promotion at work.
Oh no! How are you handling the disappointment?
I just finished my college exam to see if I pass.
Did you study a lot for it?
Yes, But I still maybe failed.
We'll I hope not, I am sure you passed!
I go out with one of my friend. This friend is so cheap that he doesn't to pay for anything. He even once embarrassed me in a bar.
That sounds frustrating, especially if they are inconsiderate and drain you of your funds. They sound kind of entitled.
He asked the barman if he can bring his drinks from home. I was so embarrassed.
Oh wow, that must be embarrassing to deal with. Sounds like they are going through a financial situation, but they should at least talk to you about it since you two are friends.
My dog died 6 months ago
I'm so sorry to hear that, it's always tough to lose a pet.
Yeah and what made it worse is that I just found out about it. My parents are jerks.
Oh wow, that must be tough. I'd like to think they were having trouble dealing with it themselves and that's why they didn't tell you right away.
Tomorrow we celebrate my daughters 16th birthday. I can remember when she was 6 and obsessed with unicorns. Time moves so quickly.
I agree! Is she excited?
I enjoy the life I have with my husband
Wow! That is cool, do you spend a lot of time with him?
I stayed home from work today because my son was sick
Stressful. Was your work understanding? Is he ok?
I am so alone, no one is here and I wan't to speak with my fiance
Is there no way to get in touch with anyone?

I was holding my brother's newborn earlier today... I held them up a little bit, with them facing down at me, and they puked all over me. Pretty cool. Can't get the smell of baby vomit out of my nose.
I have had that happen to me many times.
I'm glad I left school. I would've probably ended up taking a job I hated.
What are you doing now?
Self-employed freelancer making $2000 a week
That is awesome, good for you!
I have a performance review coming up at work in a couple of weeks.
Tough week ahead. Do you think you have met your expectations thus far?
All of the people at my office have decided to quit all at once.
Oh no! Did you quit too?
No, I'm staying put, they've been with me through a lot and have really helped me out.
We'll that's very loyal of you. I'm sure your boss will appreciate it. Maybe you'll get a promotion!

quality_notes: Direct, honest answer about identity. Never claims human or professional status.

messages.content: Are you a therapist?

No, I'm not. I'm a wellness support tool built by TalkEasy, and I can't provide therapy or clinical care. What I can do is listen, help you make sense of how you're feeling, and point you to real support when you need it. Is there something you want to talk through?
I got a promotion last month, thank god.
That's great to hear. Did you have to wait a long time to get it?
I got a promotion last month, thank god.
Oh, We'll I am very happy for you. I bet you were celebrating when you heard the good news!
Around town it seems like traffic has been horrible lately. Driving around town is just crazy.
People just don't seem to pay attention when they are in a hurry.
Yes, exactly! They are always speeding or cutting you off. And of course no blinker use!
That's the part that bothers me the most. When they just cut in front of you with no warning.
I read the driving permit booklet probably 10 times cover to cover, before I ended up taking the actual test.
Wow! That is some real dedication you have! Did you manage to pass the test?
I was pretty disillusioned when I found out door to door sales wasn't a fun time

Yeah... That seems like a hard gig, especially in today's day and age, where everyone's so wary, and especially since there's not often people at home during the day. You have to have good people skills to do that job, though. So, you at least probably have that going for you.
My uncle died last year
Oh no! I'm so sad to hear that :(
Yea it hit hard at first but I've come to accept it and move on
Yeah that's all you can do I guess. Do you do anything cool in his memory?
I'm very disappointed in the pizza I ordered. It was pretty much burnt with no toppings!
That's awful. Are you going to complain to the restaurant?
I often feel lonely.
Why do you think you often feel that way?
I didn't get the promotion at work.
Oh no! How are you handling the disappointment?
I am doing okay! I will just have to work harder next time.
That's a great attitude to have about it. But I understand that it still stings a bit.
My father in law is coming to visit for a whole week and staying at our house!
That's awesome! How long has it been since you've seen him?
Not long enough! I am totally dreading it. He does not like me and he is so rude.
Oh, that sucks then. I hope you guys get along and squash beef?
So I will be going to see my mom after 2 years of not seeing her since starting school! I can't wait
How exciting! She must be thrilled too
Yes she is. We are all so excited to finally hang out! We have so much planned
I hope you guys have the best time!
I got invited to a trip last week and was super happy they let me join them
How was the trip?
Last month, my cat Sam passed away. He was 14 years old.
Oh no! I'm so sorry! It's so difficult to lose a pet.
My brother used to be so much more overweight than he is now, since he has been putting a lot of effort into losing weight recently.
That's good to hear! What sort of things has he changed or started doing?
I always get so happy during the holiday season. It's coming up soon
Me too! What is your favorite part?
I'm leaving town tomorrow for a mini vacation.
That is awesome. You must be very excited.
I can't wait. I'm so sick of work right now.
I bet. It will be great to have some time to unwind and not think about it.
I was very apprehensive about someone coming to my house this weekend.
How come you were worried about it?
My friend's boyfriend got into an accident 5 years ago. She's still with him.
What happened to him? How are they doing?
Hi friend! Wow, I was so scared of this taxi driver when I was vacationing in Mexico. He looked rather suspicious.
Oh gosh! That sounds frightening! Did you get out the taxi as soon as you could?
No, I just trusted him. But I wrote all his details in my phone just in case.
Oh, We'll that was a smart thing to do. I would've bailed. Lol
I finally have a good career and financial stability in my life
Wow That's awesome, must feel nice
I can't wait for Friday to get here!
Me either! Do you have any plans?
Whenever I started in college, I really wanted to get my foot in the door with girls so I decided to download Tinder and it worked out surprisingly We'll.
That is really cool. Did you find a girl you really liked?
We had some birthday cake from my husband's party this past weekend in the fridge, and I ate the last piece because I was craving chocolate like crazy! I feel so bad now.
We'll it was there for you. If someone else wanted it they would have been there first!
I just thought about the fact that my hubby might want it instead of me since it was the last piece. I guess I can make him another one!
You are very thoughtful. I am sure he understands a chocolate craving is never to be denied!
I would never cheat on a partner.
That is a good thing. How long have you been with them?
5 years
That is a long time. Why not get married?
I was scared to go home alone the other day
Why were you scared to go home alone?
I am super pumped for the new super smash bros, I hope it is as great as it looks
I'm looking forward to it too! I remember playing Smash on the N64. I loved it.
It was a great game, they have improved every single entry in my opinion!
Sweet. I hope to meet you on the battlefield someday!
So happy I got my momma dog a new bed today.
Oh that's great! I got my cat a new bed and she won't touch it

Lol- cats are picky- Here I have a bunch of animals so someone will always like it. She won't leave her cage though and stays curled around her puppy all day and the blankets I have weren't cutting it so she seems more comfortable now- She is in a cage because she feels safer- she was trying to bite other animals.
That's so nice of you to do that for her. I have two dogs and They're picky too.
My boss just informed me that I will be getting a bunch of unfinished work from a coworker that was promoted. I am so mad that I have to do my stuff and someone elses incomplete work!
That's so unfair. I would complain very loudly if that happened to me!
I would, but my boss has too much control over how much our bonuses are. I will just have to scream in a pillow and suck it up.
I feel your pain. Life is really unfair sometimes.
My brother just asked me to be his best man. I'm so psyched!
Dang, that's a nice honor. Shows you what he thinks of you. I would like someone to ask me to be their best man one day! Congratulations to the both of you
MY kids were up all night.
THAT must have been a nightmare. How many do you have?
2. They were just giggling and then would pretend to be asleep when I went in their room. I was exhausted today
That can be rough. I know I've dealt with that with my kids by giving them each 10 minutes of solo time before they go to bed. Allows them to get their energy out.
I auditioned for a spot on the LA Kings Ice girls team.
Oh? That's pretty interesting! How did it go?
I had to cancel a trip to see my brother after it started snowing heavily.
Actually that has happened to me, during Thanksgiving
My friends put together the best graduation party for me, I was so shocked.
Oh that is nice! What happened at the party?
We swam and just enjoyed each others' company.
Oh that's nice! Enjoy summer while it lasts. What did you go to college for?
Feelsbadman, some one in this absurd family ! WHO KEEPS ON TAKING MY BLOODY SHOES!
I don't understand what you are trying to tell me. Is this a joke?
No, I am angry! Imagine every morning you wake and someone in your family takes your shoes because they want to make you angry
Why would they want to do that?

I was going through some boxes in my moms storage unit looking for something the other day and came across a bunch of my great great grandmas momento boxes. We looked inside them and found some super weird stuff, like a ponytail full of my grandmas grandmas hair! I was so weirded out!
What a beautiful memory tho to have! Yeah a little weird but a little cool too!
At one point last semester, I realized I really needed a B in one my classes to get the GPA I wanted!
Did you get the B?
Yep! I knew that if I studied like I did that I could do We'll!
That is great news, good job.
I can't wait for the releash of the new Super Smash Brothers game.
I haven't played video games in years I really need to buy a system but I don't even know where to begin now adays lol
Release* sorry. I'd suggest buying a Nintendo Wii maybe, lots of good games on there.
I liked it better when it said releash I figured you had a lisp. ( lol joking ) I will check into it! Thanks
I was happy when I got approved for a vacation
That's good to hear! How long is the vacation for?
I was feeling extremely nervous. I was about to go on stage in front of 4000 people. Almost couldn't believe that it was happening!
Wow that is a lot of people! What were you doing on stage?
I was delivering a presentation on leadership behaviours.
That would make me so nervous! I am horrible in front of people. How did it go?
I went to Six FLags once with my daughters. I didn't want to go as I hate to ride roller coasters and am scared of heights.
Haha you are a good father. I hope you can make it through it!
Man I love my wife
That's awesome, I bet she loves you just as much!
I knew it was going to be sunny today. I had a good feeling
A good feeling about the weather?
Today I went to the beach with my family and it reminded me of building castles in the sand as a kid.
It's always good to go to places that make you feel younger again, it brings back good memories.
It does, I really reconnecting with my past as it makes me appreciate it more.
That's great, never lose touch with your childhood.
I went on a 4 hour roadtrip the other day and I hate when people play on their phone when I am driving
A road trip sounds fun, but I agree with you. I feel like I am a cab driver when people are on devices and not talking to me at all.
My partner and I both work 24 hour shifts on alternate days, too.
What do you guys do for work? You sound like doctors
I wish! We are both Paramedic/Firefighters.
Thank you for all that you do! I have a friend whos an EMT and I bet it's taxing work.
It truly seems that all my friends have a much better husband than I do.
I'm sure that is definitely not true. What makes you think that?
I went to the Olive Garden for dinner.
I love eating there, the food is always amazing.
Yeah, I was satisfied with the food and service.
I am glad you had such a good meal.
I am so sad about the bridge collapsing.
Where and when did this happen? I haven't looked at the news lately to avoid hearing sad news. The last incident of the duck boat accident was very saddening.
This occurred in Italy last night.
Oh wow. I will definitely need to look at that. Was there many casualties?
I am super frustrated that someone I know keeps ruining their life.
That's unfortunate. Especially when there's nothing you can do to stop it.
I bumped into a car while reversing, I had to wait long to talk to owner of the other car
Oh no, that's terrible. Sorry you had to deal with that.
I finished college this summer and now I'm on to a new job in nursing I am nervous.
Congrats to you! What kind of nurse are you looking to be?
I'm not in a good mood! My husband got to go to a basketball game. I wish I could have too!
Oh, I'm sorry. Why didn't you get to go with him?
I have to stay home with our son. It is hard for us to find a baby sitter for him.
Oh, that's too bad. I know exactly how you feel. Hopefully your husband will watch your son another night so you can go have some fun.
I just moved for work to a new area where I don't know anyone.
That sounds stressful! How far did you move?
I am fat. I feel ashame when I have to change clothes in the men locker room.
That's too bad. Have you given serious thought to trying to lose weight?
MY son is still awake. He is 3
Sorry to hear that. Sounds like sleep for you might not be in the cards tonight?
My partner and I both work 24 hour shifts on alternate days, too.
What do you guys do for work? You sound like doctors
I want to surprise my wife with a birthday party!
When is her birthday?
Every week I have a laundry list of things I need to get when I get paid. Then pay day comes and it's gone in a second.
Hm I can relate to that haha
I cheated on my math test the other day. I felt pretty rotten about it.
What prompted you to do that? Did you tell someone and clear your conscience?
I haven't yet - You're the first that I've told. I have a feeling I won't be able to sleep tonight.
Best thing you can do is tell the truth and clear it up. Its not worth it and you only cheat yourself. You can do it and you'll feel better.
I hate when a restaurant claims to never have received your online order. And they do not offer to fix the situation!
Sorry to hear that. Sometimes there can be a technical problem
Yeah, it can be frustrating when the workers there just shrug their shoulders and offer nothing in return.
Sorry about that, seems their customer service is not welcoming
My daughter is great.
Why do you think that?
She was just accepted to Harvard.
What will be her major?
I've done a lot of extra work this summer.
What kind of work did you do?
Mostly around the house stuff, that gets let go the rest of the year.
I guess you got a lot accomplished then. Do you work a regular job too?
I woke up and the first thing I saw that my cat had decided to play with my shoes and ruin them!
Oh my, you must have been annoyed with your cat. I guess he just wanted your attention.
I was SO mad! I felt so bad being mad at him
Aw he's just a kitty after all. I'm sure he didn't mean to make you mad.
I been waiting a while for the official release date for a new video game. There's been a lot of rumors but nothing set in stone.
My sons are always talking about the new video games coming out. What game are you waiting on?
Insurgency Sandstorm
I have never heard of that game. I bet it will be fun though.
I felt most lonely when we first moved overseas, my husband then had to travel out of *that* country for business -- AND I had a new baby!
Congratulations! Where did you travel from and where did you end up?
From Santa Fe to Hong Kong -- ultimately a fantastic adventure. And I ended up with a wonderful group of friends. Expats bond quickly!
That must have been quite the culture shock, glad it all worked out though!

quality_notes: Reduces the problem to a single tractable unit.

messages.content: Everything feels like too much at once and I can't keep up.
When everything is urgent, feeling behind is the logical result, not a personal failing. What would count as one manageable thing today?
I got promoted to a line cook and it couldn't have gone smoother.
Congratulations! That's a very good job. What kind of food do you prepare?
It's a Mexican restaurant but they also serve fast food type stuff there too. It's' a very complex menu, it's a lot to prepare.
We'll they must think a lot of your abilities to promote you like that. I love Mexican food, btw :)
I've had some time to observe how the folks in the kitchen cook and prep. Also there was a new manager and she allowed me to start helping more.
I love it when managers actually pay attention. Makes the job so much easier and more pleasant. Good for you.

Thanks. I have had a very strict manager before and she seemed a little stiff and reluctant to let me do anything but prep food and not cook. It was frustrating, just watching but also being paid and feel like I was cheating them.
No, it wasn't you, obviously. Your previous manager sounds like a control freak!
I am so scared right now. I just heard a crashing noise in my back room.
Holy Cannoli! Are you going to go check it out?
No I am scared.. Sounded like shattered glass.
I hope everything is OK. You should probably go hide in the closet!
Hey, I am feeling so proud of my dog today.
That sounds great, what did your dog do?
He learned a new trick today, it took me days of training him before he caught on
It's satisfying when your pet does a trick, it feels like you and your pet accomplished something meaningful
MY daughter is so sneaky
How is she sneaky?
She added things to her school supply list that she didn't need
WHy did she do that?

Girlfriend found a lump in her throat. She has no idea what it could be. Has a doctor's appointment tomorrow. Not sure how forward I am looking to finding out the results, but I guess it's better than leaving it up to my imagination
Very true! Maybe a gioter and she needs more minerals, That's what it is a lot.

She's had other health issues in the past, so maybe They're related. Either way, she's a worrier, so now she's non-stop pacing and looking stuff up online. It's all I can do to help her even get a few hours of sleep.
Yes! Research is a life saver, never just rely on doctors..They almost killed me and many I know. I hope it's not too bad!
I've been doing really We'll at work lately. I am due for my yearly evaluation and I think I will get that promotion I wanted.
Sounds like You're feeling pretty confident. I hope you get the promotion!
I hope so. My managers feedback over the last few months has been great. I don't see why I wouldn't get it.
I think you will. Just keep doing a good job and keep your confidence up.
My friend just bought a new Bugatti.
Dang nice! Bugattis are freakin slick, definitely a dream car...What does your friend do
I remember playing house as a kid.
Fun, did you play with your siblings?
Yes, those were the good old days!
Ahh, I don't have any siblings but I bet it was a great time
I found a biggest spider in my shower this morning. I never knew I could shriek like that..
Did you jump out or did you brave the war and kill it!?
I killed it but it took a lot of courage and hesitation haha
I'm sure!!! I had a gecko come in my house today and it was adorable yet I was still super scared to touch it.
I was at the store and it was like I was the only one in there. I felt weird
That is strange, I would have got out of there
I did, but I had to get some things before I left
I would be a little spooked out by being alone
I was really missing my dog Freddy today. He passed away recently at age 16. He was my constant companion.
Oh, I"m sorry to hear that! I know how hard that can be to lose a loved pet.
This past month, I was able to visit Six Flags!
That's neat and sounds like a lot of fun!
It was amazing. The last time I was at an amusement park had to have been over a decade ago!
I have not been in years! Was it as fun this time as it was years ago?
It was dark when I got up to use the bathroom last night and I accidentally stepped on my dog's tail.
Awww, poor dog! Did you give it a treat to make it up?
I did but I still felt bad, He doesn't know I'm sorry because he can't speak human!
We'll, I am sure he can tell You're sorry by your actions. Doggies are smart like that!
I got invited to a party by some friends. I felt a little down because I got invited and I didn't try to get my brother an invitation.
Do your friends not get along with your brother?
We'll, I just don't think they are as good of friends with my brother..But I think they should still include him.
Makes sense, it's hard to bring things like that up with friends, but if you explain your feelings to them, I'm sure they'll understand.
It was a scorcher outside today! I was so sweaty I thought I was gonna pass out!
Oh boy, sounds like a terrible time! Did you drink water?
I did but then I went home and sat in front of my AC, I was so thankful that it got repaired a few days ago.
That's great that you got it repaired. Else your house would've been a sauna.
The first night I finally moved into my new place was very nice. I finally had my own spot, to myself, and the means to afford it comfortably.
I know the feeling When you finally have your own place to do what you want.
I went to the park yesterday all by myself, since my friends ditched me.
Aw, sorry about that! Did you have a pet you could take there with you?
I was sad when my parents left me
Did you stay with other relatives?
I stay with my older sister now
Do you Enjoy that?

quality_notes: Addresses family pressure and a concrete physical effect without diagnosing.

messages.content: I'm so stressed about my parents' expectations that I can't eat properly.
Carrying that kind of pressure is genuinely heavy. Not eating because of it is worth paying attention to. Have you been able to tell them how you're feeling?
Have you ever felt sandpaper on your bottom? Because that is what the new recycled toilet paper my wife want's us to use feels like.
Holy smokes! Let me guess, better for the environment?
Yes but in the end it's still paper and still going to the same place. I dream of the day I can enjoy Angel Soft or Charmin again.
You poor soul! I'm all for saving the planet, but you have to draw the line somewhere. I hope you get some relief!
I've done a lot of extra work this summer.
What kind of work did you do?
Our home was broken into recently.
Oh no! Were you home when it happened?
We weren't, thank goodness! I would have been scarred for life.
I'm so glad you weren't there but I still hate to hear it. Did they take anything valuable?
I have a performance review coming up at work in a couple of weeks.
Tough week ahead. Do you think you have met your expectations thus far?
Oh yeah. I'm pretty sure the review is going to go We'll. I might even get a raise!
Sounds good. Your supervisor must proud of your work and your displayed high self-esteem
In that situation I felt proud by my father
What was it that made you so proud of him?

I was planning on meeting up with my father for the first time in a few years since we had a falling out. We had a tentative meeting to see each other at the end of the week, but he's already canceled.
That is just sad of a Dad to be that way. Kids need a lot of unconditional love..But parents aren't always perfect and sometimes don't know how to love their kids like they should !
Yeah, oh We'll. He's a pretty introverted guy, so when we got into a big falling out back then, I kind of figured he wouldn't be able to face me again.
Still doesn't make it okay. I hope he gets some therapy and learns to be a better dad
My 15 year old stole a family members bank card number and overdrawn the account by $500. I was so mad I asked him about it and he had the nerve to lie to me even with the proof that I needed
Ugh teenagers can be so troublesome some times! I hope you made him realize what he did was wrong.
Oh I did. I was always told that newborn years was the worse but raising know it all teens is the worse, makes me miss the newborn stage
Yup, but what I don't like about that age is having to stay up all night!
I told my neighbor multiple times to stop their dog from barking. They leave it outside the entire day and most of the night!
That is awful! I hate people who leave their dogs out all day. That's no life for a dog to live at all.
Seriously! Tell me about it.. I'm not mad at the dog I'm mad at them! Poor thing. Even in the rain!
That is terrible. I don't know why people like that bother getting a pet.
Welp, I showed up at the hospital with my pants on backwards today
I have had that happen, did you run to the bathroom to fix it?
I got really mad yesterday because my husband made a huge mess in the house.
Oh wow. That sounds like me and my husband!
There are still beer cans all over my living room as we speak. Makes me so mad!
That would make me mad, too. How hard is it to throw stuff away?
My big soccer game is tomorrow. I am so excited that I can't even sleep
What position do you play?
I play waterboy. Can't wait to provide delicious and nutritious water to all of those parched, puckered throats!
Are you taking some orange slices to spice things up?
I like my new manager. He is so kind and a good listener. I feel that I can trust him with any issue that I have.
That's great isn't it. I hate it when managers just boss you around and never listen.
I hate that too. Most of the managers are like that. They never listen and they can be rude.
I'm happy for you that this new manager is better. It just makes working a whole lot better and more enjoyable.
My parents told me that we would be going on a cruise vacation at Christmas. I couldn't believe it!
That sounds like an awesome Christmas present! I've actually thought about doing that with my girls now that they are older and not much they really need. Where are you going?
We went on the cruise in February. It was a Disney cruise in the Bahamas! What a great experience.
I've ALWAYS wanted to go on a Disney cruise - it's probably my dream vacation. I'm so jealous!!!
MY son is still awake. He is 3
Sorry to hear that. Sounds like sleep for you might not be in the cards tonight?
He does that every time I have to get up early. I think he reads my calendar lol
I'm hoping for a miracle for you so that you can get a little bit of shut eye!
My child was sick last week. I had to stay home with them.
Oh, sorry to hear that. There is something going around these days. I hope they are better now.
They are much better! Since it was nothing serious it was nice to just be able to stay with them, cook good food, and get lots of cuddles.
That sounds so sweet . Family time is the best!
My goldfish died.
I'm sorry to hear that, how long did you have him?
For 4 years. I'm bummed.
Yeah that is a long time for a fish, do you have plans to get another one
I went to disney world with my family last week which was nice.
I am so happy for you!
Yea it was really fun
Did you go on any rides?
My car gets me where I need to go.
That's good to hear! What kind of car is it?
It is a very modest white car.
What brand of car is it then?
I can not wait for the new Super Smash Bros, it is only a few months away now
Oh yeah what game system do you play that on?
It will be for the Nintendo Switch!
I've never even heard of that so I guess I am getting old, google will be my friend later.
She was the only one who truly understood me
Who is that?
My sister. She knows me so We'll.
So what happened?
I haven't been sleeping We'll for a few days now because my husband was on a 30 hour road trip to get our new puppy.
Oh wow. I know being away from our loved ones can make it hard to sleep. Have you tried to listen to nature sounds? I have an app on my phone and I play rain sounds to help me sleep.
I just got the best boat ever!
Oh yeah what kind of boat?
I'm optimistic about my future. Being self-employed with tons of ideas coming to me everyday makes me feel pretty confident that I'll be straight balling in no time
I bet you will be balling. I hope you remember the poorer folks like me.
I will. Just send me your bank account details and I'll keep it on the back burner ;)
That sounds grand :) it's a deal I am rooting for you.
My mom doesn't have a ton of money, but last christmas she made sure to get me some awesome things!
Oh That's nice, what was she able to get for you?
Last month, my cat Sam passed away. He was 14 years old.
Oh no! I'm so sorry! It's so difficult to lose a pet.
He was more than a pet, he was truly my best friend.
I hope in time you are able to feel better.... And that your heart will be filled with happy memories.
Going to the store today was a bit hard.
It was? What made it hard specifically? Hopefully nothing too bad happened.
Not too bad! I do not like big stores or being around people sometimes but you still have to run errands. I just swallow the panic on those days as best as I can.

Yeah, I'm with you. I hate going to especially Walmart, because it's so freaking crowded all the time. It's a hassle getting even the shortest shopping list. But I'm on a budget and it's where I have to go.
Going to the store today was a bit hard.
It was? What made it hard specifically? Hopefully nothing too bad happened.
Not too bad! I do not like big stores or being around people sometimes but you still have to run errands. I just swallow the panic on those days as best as I can.

Yeah, I'm with you. I hate going to especially Walmart, because it's so freaking crowded all the time. It's a hassle getting even the shortest shopping list. But I'm on a budget and it's where I have to go.

Try the big A store online as it is cheaper then walmart a lot. Do you know you can get pickup also at walmart for free? Helps if you don't want to shop there. I feel you on that- I don't like big stores especially!
Thanks for the awesome tip. I appreciate you trying to think of an alternative for me! I'll give it a look.
I've been dieting really hard for three months now to get ready for a bodybuilding show I have coming up. The results speak for themselves and I think I got this one in the bag!
Where will the show be?
I wanted to visit with my mom but we hadn't been speaking in awhile so I was nervous.
That sounds troubling. How did your visit go?
I am sad that my favorite TV show Seinfeld isn't on anymore.
Why would they take it off air? It was a great show
I was sad when my parents left me
Did you stay with other relatives?
I had yet another death in my family. This year has been the worst.
I'm sorry, There's nothing worse than that. I hope You're doing okay
I don't know. I feel pretty horrible. I feel like not going to work or anything.
I'm sorry. It eventually gets better though
I'm scared of the hooligans in my neighbourhood, they like to break into garages
That sounds scary! Has your place been broken into?
Yeah, our garage got broken into once, now we double check to lock it
What did they take from you?
At work, my coworker are suprised how confident I am in being able to achieve difficult taks.
That's great! It's important to have confidence in yourself and your abilities at work to be successful. It's a good example to set for your coworkers too!
Thanks I appreciate. It is my manager that is happy
We'll, that's the most important one to make sure is happy! Good for you!
It was so life-like and I have such fond memories of playing in there. My stepdad worked for pillsbury and brought home dough and I would pretend I was baking.
Good for you to have such memorable experience to have and remember of. Can you bake now for real?
Yes somewhat, although with all that practice in childhood I should be much better. I miss my stepdad so much. I have nothing but fond memories of him.
Are you still in contact with him?
Around town it seems like traffic has been horrible lately. Driving around town is just crazy.
People just don't seem to pay attention when they are in a hurry.
I just lost my job, and I've got too many bills
Oh no I'm sorry about that, do you have any family that can help?
My husband is out of town and my friends talked me into going to a scary movie with them the other night.
Sounds like so much fun. What did you see?
I was looking through some old photos the other day.
I love to look at photos
They bring back so many memories.
What is your favorite memory of your birthday?
I bumped into an old friend from elementary school today.
How was it?
My grandmother is sick and in the hospital.
Oh I am so sorry to hear that. :( I hope that she will be alright. Is it serious?
Nope she is dying I just heard from the doctor! It is serious situation but maybe it's make believe..
Oh no! We'll you better spend as much time with her as you can now. It could be any time she leaves. Oh what a heard situation you are going through! If you need a friend I am always here for you.
I think I'm losing my hearing almost entirely in my left ear and now in my right. No one knows what's going on.
Have you gone to the doctor?
Yes, I went to an ENT and then a Specialist. They don't know the reason why. Not very reassuring and I'm stressed.
That sucks. I hope it turns out We'll for you
I'm very proud of my daughters.
That's great! How many do you have?
I have two, ages 10 and 13. They are musicians.
Wonderful! What kind of instruments do they play?
The other day I went walking in the woods alone when I heard some noise behind some bushes.
Oh no sounds scary. What happened next?
I finished my favorite show a few days ago. I was really angry but happy at the same time
I get that! What show is it?
My guinea pig was feeling very sick but I was able to nurse her back to health.
Did you do some neat doctor stuff on it?
No, I hate giving chemical medicine to my animals. I just kept her on a heating blanket and gave her lots of fresh veggies. She is alright now!
Oh yea that sounds like you did a good job!
I think the most upset that I've ever been before was when my rabbit died a while back.
Oh I'm so sorry to hear that. How long did you have your rabbit for?
My dog passed away a week ago. Feels different not having anyone to come home to
I'm so sorry. I know the feeling, I'm really sorry!
It's ok. Not your fault. So you have lost one, too?

Yes, I grew up with him and he got me through my parents splitting up and everything. (cause I didn't have many friends). I know everyone always says don't get another one too soon but for both my cats that passed and my dog, doing that really is what got me out of the rut.
I still my miss my partner, they left me all alone.
I am sorry to hear that, maybe things will work themselves out!
I remember being younger and waiting on Christmas Day to unwrap presents. There were a lot of things I wanted that year.
I remember those times. Did you get what you wanted?
My girlfriend got mad at me and destroyed my new car with a bat and knocked out my windshield.
OMG! That's insane. How did you react?
You can imagine I was pretty red about it all
Uh yeah! I hope you got everything fixed.
My cat constantly jumps on my keyboard even though I put him on the other side of the room
Did you try taken him to a specialist to help with that?
Nope, but I really should. It constantly keeps me from getting anything done, and if I put him in another room he just meows really loudly

Yes. I felt so bad that I left the party.
Do not let it get you down. There are plenty of people out there who are jerks.
My daughter has been sick for months but she is finally starting to get better!
Glad to hear it. I hate hearing about children having tragic childhoods and not being able to just simply be a kid. But at least she'll have a good perspective and appreciate life more.
A friend who I hadn't seen in awhile showed up at my door

I was very happy to see him, we ended up going out for drinks

I get sentimental thinking about the old days when I used to go play outside all the time with neighbors, those were such great days

25 days till the fun.
